-- FNV-1a 32-bit hash
function fnv1a_32(str)
    local hash = 0x811c9dc5
    for i = 1, #str do
        hash = bit32.bxor(hash, string.byte(str, i))
        hash = bit32.band(hash * 0x01000193, 0xFFFFFFFF)
    end
    return hash
end

-- Make a clean “reduced” slug: lowercase, dashes for spaces, strip punctuation (incl. '/').
local function toReducedSlug(name)
  local s = (name or ""):lower()
  s = s:gsub("%s+", "-")         -- spaces -> dash
  s = s:gsub("[^%w%-]", "")      -- strip everything that's not [a-z0-9-]
  s = s:gsub("%-+", "-")         -- collapse repeats
  return s
end

function sendAnalytics(eventName, player, extra)
  if version=="dev" then return end
  local sid = player and player.steam_id or ""
  -- anonymize the player's steam id
  local anonID = sid ~= "" and fnv1a_32("cruxisfine" .. sid) or 0
  local payload = {
    mod       = "Riftbound at Your LGS",
    version   = version,
    event     = eventName,
    timestamp = os.time(),
    session   = analyticsSessionID,
    player    = anonID,
    extra     = extra or {},
  }
  local body    = JSON.encode(payload)
  local headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" }

  WebRequest.custom(
    analyticsURL,      -- url
    "POST",            -- method
    true,              -- download response body
    body,              -- data to send
    headers,           -- headers
    function(req)      -- callback
      if req.is_error or req.response_code >= 400 then
        print(string.format(
          "Analytics ➜ ERROR %s: %s",
          tostring(req.response_code),
          req.error or req.text
        ))
      end
    end
  )
end

function getSnapPosition (mat, position)
  basic_position = deck_position[position]
  scale = mat.getScale()
  scaleFactor = scale.z / scale.x

  return {basic_position[1] * scaleFactor, basic_position[2], basic_position[3]}
end

function setMatSnapPoints(mat, scaleFactor)
  local inverseScale = 1 / (scaleFactor or 1)
  local snap_points = {
    {
      position = getSnapPosition(mat, "legends"),
      rotation = card_rotations["up"],
      rotation_snap = true
    },
    {
      position = getSnapPosition(mat, "champion"),
      rotation = card_rotations["up"],
      rotation_snap = true
    },
    {
      position = getSnapPosition(mat, "main"),
      rotation = card_rotations["up"],
      rotation_snap = true
    },
    {
      position = getSnapPosition(mat, "rune"),
      rotation = card_rotations["up"],
      rotation_snap = true
    },
    {
      position = getSnapPosition(mat, "trash"),
      rotation = card_rotations["up"],
      rotation_snap = true
    },
    {
      position = getSnapPosition(mat, "battlefield"),
      rotation = card_rotations["left"],
      rotation_snap = true
    }
  }

  local memory_start = -0.975 * inverseScale
  local memory_offset = 0.150 * inverseScale
  local memory_count = 14

  for memory_index = 0, memory_count - 1 do
    local memory_snap_point = {
      position = {
        memory_start + (memory_index * memory_offset),
        0,
        memory_row_z
      },
      rotation = {0, 0, 0},
      rotation_snap = true
    }
    --table.insert(snap_points, memory_snap_point)
  end

  mat.setSnapPoints(snap_points)
  mat.interactable = false
end

function glimpse1(playerColor)

  local deck = findPlayerDeckByName(playerColor, "main")
  if not deck then return end

  -- 1) Take the top card (index=0) off the deck,
  --    dropping it just above the deck so it spawns in view
  local spawnPos = deck.getPosition() + Vector(0, 2, 0)
  local card = deck.takeObject({
    index    = 0,
    position = spawnPos,
    smooth   = false
  })

  if card then
    Wait.condition(function()
      -- send it to the player’s hand (hand #2 here),
      -- then register it with the Encoder
      card.deal(1, playerColor, 2)
      Encoder.call("APIencodeObject", { obj = card })
      Encoder.call("APIobjEnableProp", { obj = card, propID = "πGlimpse" })

    end, function()
      return not card.spawning
    end)
  end
end

function moveObjectX(guid, deltaX)
    local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
    if not obj then return end

    local pos = obj.getPosition()
    pos.x = pos.x + deltaX
    obj.setPositionSmooth(pos)
end

    local pos = obj.getPosition()

end

target_playmat_width = 31.5

function setPlaymatImage(player, imageUrl)
    local player_color = player.color
    local guid = playmats[player_color]
    local originalObj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
    if not originalObj then
        print("No playmat found for color: " .. player_color)
        return
    end

    if imageUrl=="" then
      return
    end

    -- Update the image
    local custom = originalObj.getCustomObject()
    custom.image = imageUrl
    originalObj.setCustomObject(custom)
    originalObj.reload()

    -- Wait a bit for reload, then re-fetch by GUID
    Wait.time(function()

            local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
            if not obj then
                print("Waiting for object to reload...")
                return false  -- Try again
            end

            local bounds = obj.getBounds().size
            local actualWidth = bounds.x
            if actualWidth == 0 then
                print("Bounds not ready yet...")
                return false  -- Try again
            end

            -- Rescale X to match target width
            local currentScale = obj.getScale()
            local scaleFactor = target_playmat_width / actualWidth
            obj.setScale({
                x = currentScale.x * scaleFactor,
                y = currentScale.y,
                z = currentScale.z
            })

            setMatSnapPoints(obj, scaleFactor)
            return true  -- Done
    end, 0.5)
end

local function trimSpaces(str)
    if str == nil then
      return ""
    end
    return str:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
end

local function to_slug(s)
  if not s or s == "" then return "" end
  s = trimSpaces(s:lower())
  s = s:gsub("%s+", "-")
  s = s:gsub("[',]", "")
  s = s:gsub("[^%w%-]+", "-")
  s = s:gsub("%-+", "-")
  s = s:gsub("^%-+", ""):gsub("%-+$", "")
  return s
end

local function randomGUID()
    local chars = '0123456789abcdef'
    local res = {}
    for i=1,6 do
        local rand = math.random(#chars)
        res[#res+1] = chars:sub(rand, rand)
    end
    return table.concat(res)
end

    mastery = {}
}
shouldSpawnExtraDecks=false

function spawnDeck(name, cards, player, as_bag)
    if name == "references" or name == "token" or name == "generated" or name == "mastery" then
        for _, card in ipairs(cards) do
            table.insert(extraDecks[name], card)
            shouldSpawnExtraDecks=true
        end
        return -- Delay spawning until all are gathered
    end

    if name == "extra" then
        local combined = {}
        for _, group in pairs(extraDecks) do
            for _, card in ipairs(group) do
                table.insert(combined, card)
            end
        end
        cards = combined
    end

    local playmatGUID = playmats[player.color]
    if(playmatGUID==nil) then
      playmatGUID = playmats["Red"]
    end
    local playmat = getObjectFromGUID(playmatGUID)
    local rotation = playmat.getRotation()
    local position = playmat.positionToWorld(getSnapPosition(playmat, name))
    local bounds = playmat.getBounds()

    local deck = getDeck(name, cards, player)
    if as_bag or name == "extra" then
        deck = getDeckBag(name, deck, player)
    end

    deck.Transform = deck.Transform or {}
    deck.Transform.posX = position.x
    deck.Transform.posY = playmat.getPosition().y + bounds.size.y + bounds.offset.y + 1
    deck.Transform.posZ = position.z
    deck.Transform.rotY = rotation.y
    if (name=="battlefield") then
      deck.Transform.rotY = deck.Transform.rotY + 270
    end

    return spawnObjectData({data = deck})
end

function tableContains(table, value)
  for i = 1,#table do
    if (table[i]:lower() == value) then
      return true
    end
  end
  return false
end

function importRiftboundDeck(player, value, index)
    local deck_text = ui_decklist_state[player.color] or ""
    deck_text = trimSpaces(deck_text)
    if deck_text == "" then
        broadcastToColor("Paste riftmana.com TTS Code!", player.color, {1,0,0})
        return
    end

    -- Parse IDs
    local cardIDs = {}
    for id in deck_text:gmatch("%S+") do
        table.insert(cardIDs, id:upper())
    end

    if #cardIDs == 0 then
        broadcastToColor("No valid IDs!", player.color, {1,0,0})
        return
    end

    sendAnalytics("importDeck", player, { site = "TTS Code" })

    spawnRiftboundDecks(player, cardIDs)
    shouldAutoSnapshotBoardStateForPlayer[player.color] = true
    toggleImportLayout(player)
end

function spawnRiftboundDecks(player, cardIDs)
    local playmat = getObjectFromGUID(playmats[player.color])
    if not playmat then
        broadcastToColor("Playmat not found!", player.color, {1,0,0})
        return
    end

    local mainCards = {}
    local sideboardCards = {}
    local championCards = {}  -- Max 1 card
    local legends = {}
    local runeCards = {}
    local battlefieldCards = {}

    local sideboardStart = math.max(1, #cardIDs - 7)  -- Last 8 = sideboard
    local legendName = nil
    local championSlotFilled = false

    for i, cardID in ipairs(cardIDs) do
        local card = getCardData(cardID)
        if card then
            local data = parseGMNotes(card.gmNotes)
            local cardType = data.type and data.type:lower() or ""
            -- Capture legend name (first legend wins)
            if cardType == "legend" and not legendName then
                legendName = data.signature_key:lower()
                table.insert(legends, card)
            elseif cardType == "legend" then
                -- Multiple legends? Keep first, rest go to main
                table.insert(mainCards, card)
            elseif cardType == "rune" then
                table.insert(runeCards, card)
            elseif cardType == "battlefield" then
                table.insert(battlefieldCards, card)
            elseif i >= sideboardStart then
                table.insert(sideboardCards, card)
            elseif not championSlotFilled and legendName and data.signature_key:lower() == legendName then
                -- First match: goes to champion deck
                table.insert(championCards, card)
                championSlotFilled = true
            else
                -- All other cards (including extra champions) → main
                table.insert(mainCards, card)
            end
        end
    end

    local mainDeck = nil
    if #mainCards > 0 then
        local mainDeck = spawnDeck("main", mainCards, player, false)
        placeNotShuffledMarker(mainDeck, player)
    end
    if #runeCards > 0 then
        local runeDeck = spawnDeck("rune", runeCards, player, false)
        runeDeck.randomize()
    end
    if #battlefieldCards > 0 then
        spawnDeck("battlefield", battlefieldCards, player, false)
    end
    if #sideboardCards > 0 then
        spawnDeck("sideboard", sideboardCards, player, false)
    end
    if #championCards > 0 then
        spawnDeck("champion", championCards, player, false)
    end
    if #legends > 0 then
        spawnDeck("legends", legends, player, false)
    end

    broadcastToColor(
        "Riftbound imported! Main:"..#mainCards.." Side:"..#sideboardCards.." Champ:"..#championCards,
        player.color, {0,0.8,0}
    )
    sideboardingSnapshotForContainer(mainDeck)

end

-- CARD LOOKUP: Use standalone library
function getCardData(slug)
    if not Riftbound_CardLibrary then
        print("ERROR: Riftbound_CardLibrary not found!")
        return nil
    end
    local success, result = pcall(Riftbound_CardLibrary.call, "getParams", { slug = slug })
    if success and result then
        return {
            name = result.name or "Unknown",
            description = result.description or "",
            image = result.image or "",
            gmNotes = result.gmNotes or "[]",
            slug = slug
        }
    else
        print("Failed to get card: " .. slug .. " | Error: " .. tostring(result))
        return nil
    end
end

-- Parse gmNotes JSON
function parseGMNotes(gmNotes)
    local success, data = pcall(JSON.decode, gmNotes)
    return success and data or {}
end

function vecSum(v1, v2)
    return { x = v1.x + v2[1], y = v1.y + v2[2], z = v1.z + v2[3] }
end

function getDeck(name, cards, player)
    global_offset = (global_offset % 30) + 1

    local sleeve_mapping = getSleeves(player)

    local sleeve = sleeve_mapping[name] or sleeve_mapping["default"]

    local deckOffset = global_offset * 1000

    local deck_ids       = {}
    local custom_deck    = {}
    local contained_objs = {}

    local idx = 1
    for _, card in ipairs(cards) do
        local cardstomake = (card.quantity == 0 and 1) or (card.quantity or 1)

        for i = 1, cardstomake do
            local orientation = (card.orientation or ""):lower()
            local frontSide, backSide = nil, nil
            local hasOrientations = (type(card.orientations) == "table" and #card.orientations > 0)
            local isMultiState = false

            if hasOrientations then
                isMultiState = true
                local oppositeNeeded = (orientation == "front") and "back"
                    or (orientation == "back") and "front"
                    or nil

                if oppositeNeeded then
                    for b, alt in ipairs(card.orientations) do
                        if (alt.orientation==nil) or (type(alt.orientation) == "string"
                          and alt.orientation:lower() == oppositeNeeded) then
                            backSide = alt
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            local hasTypes = (type(card.types) == "table" and #(card.types) > 0)
            if hasTypes then
              if tableContains(card.types, "regalia") or tableContains(card.types, "champion") then
                sleeve = material_sleeves
              else
                sleeve = main_sleeves
              end
            end

            if orientation == "front" and backSide then
                frontSide = card

            elseif orientation == "back" and backSide then
                -- the user put the back side in their deck so we'll just flip it for them
                frontSide = backSide
                backSide  = card
            end

            if isMultiState then
                local frontKey    = (deckOffset + idx)
                local backKey     = frontKey + 1
                local frontBackKey= backKey + 1
                local frontID     = frontKey * 100
                local backID      = backKey * 100
                local frontBackID = frontBackKey * 100

                table.insert(deck_ids, frontID)


                local frontURL = frontSide.image or card_back
                local backURL  = backSide.image  or card_back

                -- This section is to work around a bug in TTS
                local altBackURL

                if backURL:find("shoutatyourdecks.com/images/") then
                    altBackURL = backURL:gsub("https://[^/]+/images/", "https://api.gatcg.com/cards/images/")
                elseif backURL:find("api.gatcg.com/cards/images/") then
                    altBackURL = backURL:gsub("https://api.gatcg.com/cards/images/", "https://shoutatyourdecks.com/images/")
                else
                    altBackURL = backURL
                end

                custom_deck[tostring(frontKey)] = {
                    FaceURL      = frontURL .. "?format="..playformat,
                    BackURL      = sleeve,
                    NumWidth     = 1,
                    NumHeight    = 1,
                    BackIsHidden = true,
                    HideWhenFaceDown = true,
                    UniqueBack   = false,
                    Type         = 0
                }
                custom_deck[tostring(backKey)] = {
                    FaceURL      = altBackURL,
                    BackURL      = sleeve,
                    NumWidth     = 1,
                    NumHeight    = 1,
                    BackIsHidden = true,
                    HideWhenFaceDown = true,
                    UniqueBack   = false,
                    Type         = 0
                }
                custom_deck[tostring(frontBackKey)] = {
                    FaceURL      = frontURL,
                    BackURL      = backURL,
                    NumWidth     = 1,
                    NumHeight    = 1,
                    BackIsHidden = false,
                    HideWhenFaceDown = false,
                    UniqueBack   = false,
                    Type         = 0
                }

                table.insert(contained_objs, {
                    GUID = randomGUID(),
                    Name = "CardCustom",
                    Transform = { scaleX = card_scale, scaleY = 1, scaleZ = card_scale },
                    Nickname = frontSide.name or "(NoName)",
                    CardID   = frontID,
                    HideWhenFaceDown = true,
                    CustomDeck = {
                        [tostring(frontKey)] = custom_deck[tostring(frontKey)]
                    },
                    States = {
                        ["2"] = {
                            GUID = randomGUID(),
                            Name = "CardCustom",
                            Transform = { scaleX = card_scale, scaleY = 1, scaleZ = card_scale },
                            Nickname = backSide.name or "(NoName)",
                            CardID   = backID,
                            HideWhenFaceDown = true,
                            CustomDeck = {
                                [tostring(backKey)] = custom_deck[tostring(backKey)]
                            }
                        },
                        ["3"] = {
                            GUID = randomGUID(),
                            Name = "CardCustom",
                            Transform = { scaleX = card_scale, scaleY = 1, scaleZ = card_scale },
                            Nickname = frontSide.name .. " / " .. backSide.name or "(NoName)",
                            CardID   = frontBackID,
                            HideWhenFaceDown = false,
                            CustomDeck = {
                                [tostring(frontBackKey)] = custom_deck[tostring(frontBackKey)]
                            }
                        }
                    }
                })
                idx = idx + 3
            else
                local singleKey = deckOffset + idx
                local singleID  = singleKey * 100

                table.insert(deck_ids, singleID)

                local faceUrl = card.image or card_back

                custom_deck[tostring(singleKey)] = {
                    FaceURL      = faceUrl .. "?format="..playformat,
                    BackURL      = sleeve,
                    NumWidth     = 1,
                    NumHeight    = 1,
                    BackIsHidden = true,
                    HideWhenFaceDown = true,
                    UniqueBack   = false,
                    Type         = 0
                }

                table.insert(contained_objs, {
                    GUID = randomGUID(),
                    Name = "CardCustom",
                    Description = card.slug,
                    GMNotes = card.gmNotes,
                    Transform = { scaleX = card_scale, scaleY = 1, scaleZ = card_scale },
                    Nickname = card.name,
                    CardID   = singleID,
                    HideWhenFaceDown = true,
                    CustomDeck = {
                        [tostring(singleKey)] = custom_deck[tostring(singleKey)]
                    }
                })
                idx = idx + 1
            end
        end
    end

    if #contained_objs == 1 then
        contained_objs[1].Transform.rotZ = 180
        return contained_objs[1]
    else
        return {
            GUID = randomGUID(),
            Name = "Deck",
            Transform = {
                rotX = 360, rotY = 180, rotZ = 180,
                scaleX = card_scale, scaleY = 1, scaleZ = card_scale
            },
            Nickname = name,
            DeckIDs = deck_ids,
            CustomDeck = custom_deck,
            ContainedObjects = contained_objs
        }
    end
end

function placeNotShuffledMarker(obj, player)
  if obj then
    local markerGUID = notshuffledmarkers[player.color]
    local marker = getObjectFromGUID(markerGUID)
    if marker then
      local playmatGUID = playmats[player.color]
      local playmat = getObjectFromGUID(playmatGUID)

      if playmat then
        local rot = playmat.getRotation()
        marker.setRotation(rot)
        if(rot.y>90) then
          marker.setPosition(obj.getPosition() + Vector(6, 0, 0))
        else
          marker.setPosition(obj.getPosition() + Vector(-6, 0, 0))
        end
      end

      marker.setName("Not Shuffled Marker")
      marker.setVar("ownerColor", player.color)
    end
  end
end

function importDeck(player, value, index)
    local deck_text = ui_decklist_state[player.color]
    deck_text = trimSpaces(deck_text)

    if deck_text == "" then
        broadcastToColor("No Decklist URL provided!", player.color, {255,0,0})
        return
    end

    if deck_text:match("^{") then
      local json = JSON.decode(deck_text)
      if json then
          if json.error == nil then
              SpawnDeckFromJson(json, player, value, index)
              shouldAutoSnapshotBoardStateForPlayer[player.color] = true
              return
          end
      end
    end

    if importDeckFromURL(deck_text, player, value, index) then
        return
    end    -- deck_text:match("^https?://")

    broadcastToColor("Invalid deck input! Provide a valid JSON decklist or a URL.", player.color, {255,0,0})
end

function importDeckFromURL(deck_url, player, value, index)

  if deck_url ~= nil and deck_url:len() > 0 then
    if deck_url:sub(1, 5) ~= "https" then
      deck_url = "https://" .. deck_url
    end

    -- Silvie
    if deck_url:find("silvie.org") ~= nil or deck_url:find("silv.ie") then
        if deck_url:find("format=json") == nil then
            if deck_url:find("?") == nil then
              deck_url = deck_url .. "?format=json"
            else
              deck_url = deck_url .. "&format=json"
            end
        end
        sendAnalytics("importDeck", player, { site = "silvie.org" })
    elseif deck_url:find("shoutatyourdecks.com") ~= nil then
        deck_url = deck_url:gsub("/decks/", "/api/")
        sendAnalytics("importDeck", player, { site = "shoutatyourdecks.com" })
    elseif deck_url:find("silvie.gg") ~= nil then
        deck_url = deck_url:gsub("silvie.gg/decklist%?deck=", "build.silvie.gg/deck/")
        deck_url = deck_url:gsub("silvie.gg/decklist/", "build.silvie.gg/deck/")
        sendAnalytics("importDeck", player, { site = "silvie.gg" })
    elseif deck_url:find("jsonblob.com") ~= nil then
        deck_url = deck_url:gsub("jsonblob.com/", "jsonblob.com/api/jsonBlob/")
        sendAnalytics("importDeck", player, { site = "jsonblob.com" })
    elseif deck_url:find("tcgarchitect.com") ~= nil then
        deck_url = deck_url:gsub("tcgarchitect.com/grand%-archive/decks/", "api.tcgarchitect.com/tts/grand-archive/deck/")
        deck_url = deck_url:gsub("tcgarchitect.com/grand%-archive/tournaments/decklists/", "api.tcgarchitect.com/tts/grand-archive/tournament-deck/")
        sendAnalytics("importDeck", player, { site = "tcgarchitect.com" })
    elseif deck_url:find("fractalofin.site") ~= nil then
        local event_id, player_id,suffix
        local patterns = {
            { pattern = "/player/(%d+).html#deck_(%d+)", swap = true, suffix=""  }, -- player page
            { pattern = "#deck_(%d+)_(%d+)",             swap = false, suffix="" }, -- card/archetype page
            { pattern = "/%w+/(%d+).html#deck_(%d+)_topcut",    swap = false, suffix="_topcut" },  -- event page
            { pattern = "/%w+/(%d+).html#deck_(%d+)",    swap = false, suffix="" },  -- event page
        }

        for _, entry in ipairs(patterns) do
            local first, second = deck_url:match(entry.pattern)
            if first and second then
                player_id = entry.swap and tonumber(first) or tonumber(second)
                event_id = entry.swap and tonumber(second) or tonumber(first)
                suffix = entry.suffix
                break
            end
        end

        if event_id and player_id then
            deck_url = "https://fractalofin.site/tts/event_" .. event_id .. "/" .. player_id .. suffix .. ".json"
        else
            broadcastToColor("Invalid Fractalofin URL format!", player.color, {255,0,0})
            return
        end
        sendAnalytics("importDeck", player, { site = "fractalofin.site" })
    else
        broadcastToColor("Invalid Decklist URL!", player.color, {255,0,0})
        return false
    end

    WebRequest.get(deck_url, function(req)
      if req.is_error then
        log(req.error)
      else
        json = JSON.decode(req.text)
        if json.error ~= nil then
          log(json.error)
          if json.error == "silvie/bad-request" then
            broadcastToColor("Invalid Silvie.org Decklist!", player.color, {255,0,0})
          else
            broadcastToColor("Unknown Error :(", player.color, {255,0,0})
          end
          return false
        else
          -- Generate Cards
          for deck, cards in pairs(json.cards) do
            if #cards > 0 then
              local obj = spawnDeck(deck, cards, player, index=="import_deck_bag")
              -- temporarily disabled
              placeNotShuffledMarker(obj, player)
            end
          end
          if shouldSpawnExtraDecks then
            spawnDeck("extra", {}, player, true)
          end
          extraDecks = {
              references = {},
              token = {},
              generated = {},
              mastery = {}
          }
          shouldSpawnExtraDecks=false
          local mainDeck = findPlayerDeckByName(player.color, "main")
          deckcounts[player.color][2] = math.max(60, #mainDeck.getObjects())
          deleteBoardedCopies(player.color)
          createBoardedCopies(player.color)
          toggleImportLayout(player)
        end
      end
    end)
    return true
  end
end

local function getRuneCards(zone)

  return t

local function zoneHasDecks(zone)
  for _, o in ipairs(zone.getObjects() or {}) do

  return false
end

local function objectIsInZone(obj, zone)

  end

end

-- Wait until: (a) no Decks remain in the zone and (b) all cards are not smooth-moving
local function waitRunesCalm(zone, cb)
  Wait.condition(cb, function()
    if zoneHasDecks(zone) then return false end
    for _, c in ipairs(getRuneCards(zone)) do
      if c.isSmoothMoving() then return false end
    end
    return true
  end)
end

-- Only reorganize when there WERE stacks
local function reorganizeMemoryZoneOnly(color, done)
  local zone = getRuneZone(color)
  if not zone then if done then done() end return end

  local hadDecks = zoneHasDecks(zone)
  if not hadDecks then
    if done then done() end
    return
  end

  splitDecksInZone(zone)

  -- brief delay for spawned singles, then lay out evenly and wait until calm
  Wait.time(function()
    local memPos      = zone.getPosition()
    local memoryCards = getRuneCards(zone)
    reorganizeMemoryForTotal(memoryCards, memPos, #memoryCards)

    waitRunesCalm(zone, function()
      if done then done() end
    end)
  end, 0.2)
end


function performBanishRoulette(cardsInMemory, targetCard, onDone)
  local cfg = banishAnim or {
    enabled     = true,
    totalTime   = 0.6,
    flashTime   = 0.12,
    perStepMin  = 0.04,
    perStepMax  = 0.12,
    maxCards    = 30,
    colorAll    = {1.0, 0.9, 0.2},  -- yellow
    colorOut    = {1.0, 0.35, 0.35},-- red
    colorTarget = {0.35, 1.0, 0.55} -- green
  }

  if not cfg.enabled or #cardsInMemory <= 1 or #cardsInMemory > cfg.maxCards then
    if onDone then onDone() end
    return
  end

  -- Build elimination order (all non-targets, shuffled)
  local pool = {}
  for _, c in ipairs(cardsInMemory) do if c ~= targetCard then table.insert(pool, c) end end
  for i = #pool, 2, -1 do local j = math.random(i); pool[i], pool[j] = pool[j], pool[i] end

  local flashT  = cfg.flashTime or 0.12
  local steps   = #pool
  local budget  = math.max(0, (cfg.totalTime or 0.6) - flashT)
  local perStep = (steps > 0) and (budget / steps) or 0
  perStep       = math.max(cfg.perStepMin or 0.04, math.min(cfg.perStepMax or 0.12, perStep))
  local keepAll = flashT + steps * perStep + 0.25  -- keep yellow long enough to cover eliminations

  -- Stage A: keep EVERYONE yellow for the whole sequence
  for _, c in ipairs(cardsInMemory) do
    if c and not c.isDestroyed() then c.highlightOn(cfg.colorAll, keepAll) end
  end

  -- Stage B: elimination — flash red then turn OFF each non-target
  Wait.time(function()
    for idx, c in ipairs(pool) do
      Wait.time(function()
        if c and not c.isDestroyed() then
          local pulse = math.max(0.06, perStep * 0.6)
          c.highlightOn(cfg.colorOut, pulse)
          Wait.time(function()
            if c and not c.isDestroyed() then c.highlightOff() end
          end, pulse)
        end
      end, (idx - 1) * perStep)
    end

    -- Stage C: crown the target, then finish
    Wait.time(function()
      if targetCard and not targetCard.isDestroyed() then
        -- If target was kept yellow, overwrite with a short green crown
        targetCard.highlightOn(cfg.colorTarget, 0.8)
      end
      if onDone then onDone() end
    end, steps * perStep + 0.02)

  end, flashT)
end


-- Actually move the selected card to banish
local function banishCardToZone(color, card)
  local mat = getPlaymat(color)
  if not (mat and card) then return end
  local banishPos = mat.positionToWorld(deck_position["banished"])
  card.setPositionSmooth(banishPos)
  card.setRotationSmooth(card_rotations["left"])
end

-- Process a single queued banish request
local function processNextBanish()
  if isBanishBusy then return end
  if #banishQueue == 0 then return end

  -- lock first to avoid races from multiple callers
  isBanishBusy = true
  local job = table.remove(banishQueue, 1)
  if not job then isBanishBusy = false; return end

  local color = job.color
  local zone  = getRuneZone(color)
  if not zone then isBanishBusy = false; processNextBanish(); return end

  -- if there are stacks, split & re-layout; otherwise skip straight to pick
  local function afterReady()
    local cards = getRuneCards(zone)
    if #cards == 0 then
      isBanishBusy = false
      processNextBanish()
      return
    end
    local target = cards[math.random(#cards)]
    performBanishRoulette(cards, target, function()
      banishCardToZone(color, target)
      isBanishBusy = false
      processNextBanish()
    end)
  end

  if zoneHasDecks(zone) then
    reorganizeMemoryZoneOnly(color, afterReady)
  else
    -- no decks; optionally ensure nothing is still moving
    Wait.condition(afterReady, function()
      for _, c in ipairs(getRuneCards(zone)) do
        if c.isSmoothMoving() then return false end
      end
      return true
    end)
  end
end

  table.insert(banishQueue, { color = player.color })

function findPlayerDeckByName(player_color, name_fragment)
    local playmat = getObjectFromGUID(playmats[player_color])
    if not playmat then return end

    local minBound, maxBound = getPlaymatBounds(player_color)

    -- Try first by name matching
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        local pos = obj.getPosition()
        if obj.tag == "Deck"
        and obj.getName():lower():find(name_fragment:lower())
        and isPointInBounds(pos, minBound, maxBound) then
            return obj
        end
    end

    -- If no deck with matching name, fallback to position check

    local snap_offset = getSnapPosition(playmat, name_fragment:lower())
    if not snap_offset then return nil end  -- unknown type

    local targetPos = playmat.positionToWorld(snap_offset)

    -- Find closest deck to the expected snap point
    local bestDeck = nil
    local bestDist = 1 -- usually like 0.3ish

    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj.tag == "Deck" or obj.tag == "Card" then
            local dist = (obj.getPosition() - targetPos):magnitude()
            if dist < bestDist then
                bestDeck = obj
                bestDist = dist
            end
        end
    end

    return bestDeck
end

local function getVisibleDeckEntry(deck)
  local list = deck.getObjects() or {}
  if #list == 0 then return nil end

  local pick, maxIndex = list[1], (list[1].index or -1)
  for _, e in ipairs(list) do
    local idx = e.index or -1
    if idx > maxIndex then
      pick, maxIndex = e, idx
    end
  end
  return pick or list[#list]
end

function performResetFlourish(player, deck, sleeve_url)
    if not deck or deck.tag ~= "Deck" then return end

    local count = #deck.getObjects()
    if count < 3 then return end

    local center = deck.getPosition()
    local radius = 5
    local fixedCount = 12
    local angleStep = (2 * math.pi) / fixedCount

    local total = math.min(count, 30)
    local cardsToAnimate = total - 2
    local animDuration = 0.5
    local delayPerCard = animDuration / cardsToAnimate

    for i = 1, cardsToAnimate do
        local angle = angleStep * i
        local offset = Vector(math.cos(angle) * radius, 2, math.sin(angle) * radius)
        local delay = (i - 1) * delayPerCard

        Wait.time(function()
            local ghost = spawnObject({
                type = "Card",
                position = center + offset,
                rotation = {0, 0, 180},
                scale = {0.95, 0.95, 0.95},
                sound = false

            })

            if ghost then
                ghost.setCustomObject({
                  face = sleeve_url,
                  back = sleeve_url
                })

                ghost.setLock(true)
                ghost.setName("Flourish")
                ghost.setDescription("")

                Wait.time(function()
                    ghost.setPositionSmooth(center + Vector(0, 2 + i * 0.1, 0), false, true)
                end, 0.2)

                Wait.time(function()
                    if ghost then ghost.destruct() end
                end, 1.0)
            end
        end, delay)
    end
end

function getBoundsOfDeckZone (player_color, zoneName)
  local playmat = getObjectFromGUID(playmats[player_color])
  local localPos = getSnapPosition(playmat, zoneName)

  if playmat and localPos then

      local worldPos = playmat.positionToWorld(localPos)

      local halfSizeX = 2.0
      local halfSizeY = 2.0
      local halfSizeZ = 2.0

      local minBound = Vector(worldPos.x - halfSizeX, worldPos.y - halfSizeY, worldPos.z - halfSizeZ)
      local maxBound = Vector(worldPos.x + halfSizeX, worldPos.y + halfSizeY, worldPos.z + halfSizeZ)

      return minBound, maxBound

  end
end

            end
          )
        end,
        function()

function channelOneRune(player, value, index, offset)
    local player_color = player.color
    local targetposition = getObjectFromGUID(playerrunezones[player_color]).getPosition()
    local targetrotation = getObjectFromGUID(playerrunezones[player_color]).getRotation()
    targetrotation.y=180-targetrotation.y
    if (offset) then
      targetposition.x = targetposition.x + 4
    else
      targetposition.x = targetposition.x - 4
    end

    local runeDeck = findPlayerDeckByName(player_color, "rune")
    cardTaken = nil

    if runeDeck then
      if runeDeck.tag == "Deck" then

        if not runeDeck then
            broadcastToColor("No Rune Deck found!", player_color, {1,0,0})
            return cardTaken
        end

        local deckObjs = runeDeck.getObjects()
        if #deckObjs == 0 then
            broadcastToColor("Rune Deck empty!", player_color, {1,0,0})
            return cardTaken
        end

        cardTaken = runeDeck.takeObject({
            index = 0,  -- Top card
            position = targetposition,
            flip = true
        })
        return cardTaken
      elseif runeDeck.tag == "Card" then
        runeDeck.setPositionSmooth(targetposition, false, true)
        runeDeck.setRotationSmooth(targetrotation, false, true)
        cardTaken = runeDeck
      end
    end
    return cardTaken
end

function wakeUpOneObject(playmat, obj)
  local rot = obj.getRotation()
  local isFaceDown = rot.z > 90 and rot.z < 270

  local newRot = {
      x = playmat.getRotation().x,
      y = playmat.getRotation().y,
      z = isFaceDown and 180 or 0
  }

  local delta = math.abs(obj.getRotation().y-newRot.y)
  obj.setRotationSmooth(newRot)
  return (delta>45)
end

function wakeUpEverythingOnPlaymat(player, value, index)
    local playmat = getObjectFromGUID(playmats[player.color])
    if not playmat then return end

    local minBound, maxBound = getPlaymatBounds (player.color)
    local minBoundBanish, maxBoundBanish = getBoundsOfDeckZone (player.color, "banished")
    local lastrotatingobject = nil

    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj.tag == "Card" or obj.tag == "Deck" then
            local pos = obj.getPosition()

            if isPointInBounds(pos, minBound, maxBound) and not isPointInBounds(pos, minBoundBanish, maxBoundBanish) then
              local moving = wakeUpOneObject(playmat, obj)
              if moving then
                lastrotatingobject = obj
              end
            end
        end
    end
    return lastrotatingobject
end

function isPointInBounds(point, minBound, maxBound)

  return point.x >= minBound.x and point.x <= maxBound.x and
     point.y >= minBound.y and point.y <= maxBound.y and
     point.z >= minBound.z and point.z <= maxBound.z
end

function reserveIntoMemory(player, value, index)
    local memoryGuid = playermrunezones[player.color]
    local memoryZone = getObjectFromGUID(memoryGuid)
    if not memoryZone then
        log("Memory Zone for player " .. player.color .. " is nil.")
        return
    end

    local handGuid = playerhandzones[player.color]
    local handZone = getObjectFromGUID(handGuid)
    if not handZone then
        log("Hand Zone for player " .. player.color .. " is nil.")
        return
    end

    -- Find how many cards are already in the memory zone
    local memPos = memoryZone.getPosition()
    local memObjects = memoryZone.getObjects()
    local existingCount = 0
    for _, obj in ipairs(memObjects) do
        if obj.tag == "Card" then
            existingCount = existingCount + 1
        end
    end

    local spacing = -3.2
    local initial = 9.5
    local cardsToMove = {}

    if (memPos.z <0) then
      spacing = spacing * -1
      initial = initial * -1
    end


    local handObjects = handZone.getObjects()
    if handObjects then
        for _, item in ipairs(handObjects) do
            if item.tag == "Card" then
                local rot = item.getRotation()
                if math.abs(item.getRotation().z) > 90 then
                    table.insert(cardsToMove, item)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for i, card in ipairs(cardsToMove) do
        local offset = existingCount + (i - 1)
        local pos = {
            x = memPos.x + initial + offset%7 * spacing,
            y = memPos.y + 2,
            z = memPos.z
        }
        local quickPos = {
          x = (card.getPosition().x+pos.x)/2,
          y = (card.getPosition().y+pos.y+40)/2,
          z = (card.getPosition().z+pos.z)/2
        }
        card.setPosition(quickPos)
        card.setPositionSmooth(pos)
    end
end

function reorganizeMemory(player, value, index)
    local memoryGuid = playerrunezones[player.color]
    local memoryZone = getObjectFromGUID(memoryGuid)
    if not memoryZone then
        log("Memory Zone for " .. player.color .. " is nil.")
        return
    end

    local memPos = memoryZone.getPosition()
    local memObjects = memoryZone.getObjects()
    local cardsInMemory = {}

    for _, obj in ipairs(memObjects) do
        if obj.tag == "Card" then
            table.insert(cardsInMemory, obj)
        end
    end

    local count = #cardsInMemory
    if count == 0 then return end

    local baseCount = 7
    local baseSpacing = 3.2
    local maxWidth = (baseCount - 1) * baseSpacing  -- distance for 7 cards is 6 * 3.2 = 19.2
    local spacingSign = (memPos.z < 0) and -1 or 1
    local initial = (memPos.z > 0) and -9.5 or 9.5

    -- if count <= 7, use normal spacing; else shrink spacing so they all fit within the same total width
    local effectiveSpacing
    if count <= baseCount then
        effectiveSpacing = baseSpacing * spacingSign
    else
        effectiveSpacing = (maxWidth / (count - 1)) * spacingSign
    end

    for i, card in ipairs(cardsInMemory) do
        -- place them from left to right
        local offset = i - 1
        local finalPos = {
            x = memPos.x + initial + (offset * effectiveSpacing),
            y = memPos.y + 2,
            z = memPos.z
        }
        card.setPositionSmooth(finalPos)
    end
end

-- Helper: split any Deck in the zone into single cards, laid out in a line
function splitDecksInZone(zone)
    local pos = zone.getPosition()
    for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
        if obj.tag == "Deck" then
            local contents = obj.getObjects() or {}
            local n        = #contents
            if n > 0 then
                local spacing = 0.6                       -- distance between cards
                local startX  = pos.x - spacing*(n-1)/2  -- center the line
                for i = 1, n do
                    local x = startX + (i-1)*spacing
                    obj.takeObject({
                        index    = 1,
                        position = { 4*x, pos.y + 2, pos.z+0.5 },
                        smooth   = false
                    })
                end
            end
            obj.destruct()
        end
    end
end

function reserveAndReorganizeMemory(player, value, index)
    -- 1) get the memory zone
    local memZone = getObjectFromGUID(playerrunezones[player.color])
    if not memZone then
        log("Memory Zone for " .. player.color .. " is nil.")
        return
    end

    -- 2) split any decks into cards
    splitDecksInZone(memZone)

    -- 3) wait a moment for those new cards to appear
    Wait.time(function()
        local memPos = memZone.getPosition()

        -- 4) gather all cards now in memory
        local memoryCards = {}
        for _, o in ipairs(memZone.getObjects()) do
            if o.tag == "Card" then
                table.insert(memoryCards, o)
            end
        end
        local memCount = #memoryCards

        -- 5) find face-down cards in hand
        local handZone = getObjectFromGUID(playerhandzones[player.color])
        if not handZone then
            log("Hand Zone for " .. player.color .. " is nil.")
            return
        end
        local cardsToMove = {}
        for _, c in ipairs(handZone.getObjects() or {}) do
            if c.tag == "Card" and math.abs(c.getRotation().z) > 90 then
                table.insert(cardsToMove, c)
            end
        end
        local handCount = #cardsToMove

        -- 6) compute total and reorganize existing memory
        local totalCount = memCount + handCount
        reorganizeMemoryForTotal(memoryCards, memPos, totalCount)

        -- 7) if no new cards, we’re done
        if handCount == 0 then
            return
        end

        -- 8) otherwise wait a bit more, then move the new cards in place
        Wait.time(function()
            for i, card in ipairs(cardsToMove) do
                local offset   = memCount + (i - 1)
                local finalPos = getMemoryPosition(memPos, offset, totalCount)

                -- quick mid-air reposition
                local cp = card.getPosition()
                card.setPosition({
                    x = (cp.x + finalPos.x) / 2,
                    y = (cp.y + finalPos.y + 40) / 2,
                    z = (cp.z + finalPos.z) / 2,
                })
                card.setPositionSmooth(finalPos)
            end
        end, 0.5)

    end, 0.2)
end


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Helper: Reorganize existing memory cards for a future total
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function reorganizeMemoryForTotal(cardsInMemory, memPos, futureTotal)
    if #cardsInMemory == 0 then return end

    local spacingSign = (memPos.z < 0) and 1 or -1

    table.sort(cardsInMemory, function(a, b)
      return a.getPosition().x*spacingSign < b.getPosition().x*spacingSign
    end)

    local baseCount = 7
    local baseSpacing = 3.2
    local ySpacing = 0.05
    local maxWidth = (baseCount - 1) * baseSpacing


    local effectiveSpacing
    if futureTotal <= baseCount then
        effectiveSpacing = baseSpacing * spacingSign
    else
        effectiveSpacing = (maxWidth / (futureTotal - 1)) * spacingSign
    end

    -- same centered layout logic
    local startOffset = (futureTotal - 1) / 2
    local initial = memPos.x - startOffset * effectiveSpacing
    local yPos = memPos.y + 1
    local zPos = memPos.z

    for i, card in ipairs(cardsInMemory) do
        local offset = (i - 1)
        local finalPos = {
            x = initial + offset * effectiveSpacing,
            y = yPos + offset * ySpacing,
            z = zPos
        }
        card.setPositionSmooth(finalPos)
    end
end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Helper: Calculate final position for a new card offset
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function getMemoryPosition(memPos, offset, futureTotal)
    local baseCount = 7
    local baseSpacing = 3.2
    local maxWidth = (baseCount - 1) * baseSpacing
    local spacingSign = (memPos.z < 0) and 1 or -1

    local effectiveSpacing
    if futureTotal <= baseCount then
        effectiveSpacing = baseSpacing * spacingSign
    else
        effectiveSpacing = (maxWidth / (futureTotal - 1)) * spacingSign
    end

    local startOffset = (futureTotal - 1) / 2
    local initialX = memPos.x - startOffset * effectiveSpacing
    return {
        x = initialX + offset * effectiveSpacing,
        y = memPos.y + 2,
        z = memPos.z
    }
end

-- Wait until the object is stable, optionally switch to newState, then call thenFn (if provided).
function waitToSwitchState(obj, newState, thenFn)
  if not obj or obj.isDestroyed() then return end

  local function stable()
    return obj and not obj.isDestroyed()
       and not obj.isSmoothMoving()
       and not obj.spawning
  end

  local function afterSettled()
    if thenFn then thenFn() end
  end

  local cur = obj.getStateId()
  if cur == newState then
    -- Already in desired state; just wait for stability
    Wait.condition(afterSettled, stable)
    return
  end

  if cur ~= -1 then
    -- Switch state, then wait for it to finish
    obj.setState(newState)
    Wait.condition(afterSettled, function()
      return stable() and obj.getStateId() == newState
    end)
  else
    -- No alt states; just wait for stability and continue
    Wait.condition(afterSettled, stable)
  end
end


function getLastStateIndex(obj)
  local states = obj.getStates()
  if states ~= nil then
    return #states+1
  end
  return 1
end

function onObjectLeaveZone(zone, obj)
    if obj.tag == "Card" then
        if obj.getStateId() == getLastStateIndex(obj) then
          if zone.getName() == "Field" then
              if not obj.isDestroyed() then
                waitToSwitchState(obj, 1)
              end
          end
        end
    end
end

local function getVisibleDeckEntry(deck)
  local list = deck.getObjects() or {}
  if #list == 0 then return nil end

  local pick, maxIndex = list[1], (list[1].index or -1)
  for _, e in ipairs(list) do
    local idx = e.index or -1
    if idx > maxIndex then
      pick, maxIndex = e, idx
    end
  end
  return pick or list[#list]
end

local function subjectCardName(obj)
  if not obj then return nil end
  if obj.tag == "Card" then
    return obj.getName()
  elseif obj.tag == "Deck" then
    local entry = getVisibleDeckEntry(obj)
    if entry then
      -- entry.nickname is usually the printed title; fall back to name
      return entry.nickname or entry.name
    end
  end
  return nil
end

local function subjectCardName(obj)
  local name = obj.getName() or ""
  local front, back = name:match("^%s*(.-)%s*/%s*(.-)%s*$")
  if not front then
    return name -- single-sided (or already a clean name)
  end
  -- In your table: z ~ 0 => face-down, z ~ 180 => face-up
  local isFaceDown = (math.abs(obj.getRotation().z) > 90)
  return isFaceDown and back or front
end

function onObjectRotate(rotated_object, spin, flip, player_color, old_spin, old_flip)
    if rotated_object.tag ~= "Card" then return end

    local fieldGUID    = playerfields[player_color]
    local runezoneGUID = playerrunezones[player_color]
    if not fieldGUID or not runezoneGUID then return end

    local type = data and data.type
    if type ~= "rune" then return end

    -- your original tap logic from spin:
    local isTapped = (spin > 45) and math.abs(spin - 180) > 45

    -- tell the repositioner which rune changed, and what its intended state is
    repositionAllRunesInZone(player_color, rotated_object, isTapped)
end

-- 0 / 180 / 360 = UNTAPPED
-- 90 / 270      = TAPPED
-- ±45° threshold around each
function isRotationTapped(rotY, debugLabel)
    if (rotY > 45 and rotY < 135) or (rotY > 225 and rotY < 315) then
      return true
    end
    return false
end

-- tappedRune: the rune that was just rotated (may be nil)
-- tappedState: boolean, true=tapped, false=untapped (only relevant if tappedRune is non-nil)
function repositionAllRunesInZone(player_color, tappedRune, tappedState)
    local runeZone = getObjectFromGUID(playerrunezones[player_color])
    if not runeZone then return end

    local allObjects = runeZone.getObjects()
    local runesByPile = {}  -- {color1_untapped = {rune1, ...}, color1_tapped = {...}, ...}

    -- Categorize runes
    for _, obj in ipairs(allObjects) do
        if obj.tag == "Card" then
            local data = parseGMNotes(obj.getGMNotes())
            if data and data.type == "rune" then
                local color_identity = data.color_identity
                local color = normalizeRuneColor(color_identity)
                local colorIdx = getColorIndex(player_color, color)
                if colorIdx > 0 then
                    local isTapped
                    if tappedRune and obj == tappedRune then
                        -- override: trust the state from onObjectRotate
                        isTapped = tappedState and true or false
                    else
                        -- fallback: infer from rotation
                        local rotY = obj.getRotation().y
                        isTapped = isRotationTapped(rotY, "rune "..obj.getName())
                    end

                    local pileKey = "color" .. colorIdx .. (isTapped and "_tapped" or "_untapped")
                    if not runesByPile[pileKey] then runesByPile[pileKey] = {} end
                    table.insert(runesByPile[pileKey], obj)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local zonePos = runeZone.getPosition()
    local zoneRot = runeZone.getRotation()

    local rotationIsFlipped = zoneRot.y>90 and zoneRot.y<270

    local rotationMultiplier = rotationIsFlipped and -1 or 1

    local baseY       = 1.00
    local fanStepX    = -0.7 * rotationMultiplier  -- how much to fan along X
    local fanStepZ    = 0.4 * rotationMultiplier  -- how much to fan along Z
    local heightStep  = 0.1   -- how much higher each step on the positive side
    local rotJitter   = 0.5

    for pileKey, runes in pairs(runesByPile) do
        local posOffset = pilePositions[pileKey]
        if posOffset and #runes > 0 then
            -- ensure tappedRune (if in this pile) is LAST so it ends on top
            if tappedRune then
                for i, r in ipairs(runes) do
                    if r == tappedRune then
                        table.remove(runes, i)
                        table.insert(runes, r) -- now last
                        break
                    end
                end
            end

            local baseX = zonePos.x + posOffset.x * rotationMultiplier
            local baseZ = zonePos.z + posOffset.z * rotationMultiplier

            local n = #runes
            local center = (n + 1) / 2
            local pileIsTapped = (pileKey:match("_tapped") ~= nil)

            for i, rune in ipairs(runes) do
                local idxOffset = (i - center)

                local finalPos = {
                    x = baseX + idxOffset * fanStepX,
                    y = baseY + i * heightStep,  -- higher on the positive x/z side
                    z = baseZ + idxOffset * fanStepZ
                }

                rune.setPositionSmooth(finalPos, false, true)

                local yaw = zoneRot.y + (pileIsTapped and 270 or 180)
                yaw = yaw + (idxOffset * rotJitter)

                rune.setRotation(Vector(zoneRot.x, yaw, zoneRot.z))
            end
        end
    end
end


-- Helper: Normalize rune color
function normalizeRuneColor(color_identity)
    if not color_identity then return "unknown" end
    return color_identity:lower():match("^%s*([^,%s]+)") or "unknown"
end

    local playerColors = getPlayerRuneColors(player_color)
    for i, c in ipairs(playerColors) do

function handleBottomDeck(droppedObject, player_color)
    local data = parseGMNotes(droppedObject.getGMNotes())
    local deck = findPlayerDeckByName(player_color, "main")
    if (data.type == "rune") then
        deck = findPlayerDeckByName(player_color, "rune")
    end
    if not deck then
        broadcastToColor("Cannot find your deck!", player_color, {1,0,0})
        return
    end

    local deckPos = deck.getPosition()
    local liftedPos = Vector(deckPos.x, 4, deckPos.z)  -- Lift even higher

    -- Step 1: Lock and Lift the deck
    deck.setLock(true)
    deck.setPositionSmooth(liftedPos, false, true)

    Wait.time(function()
        -- Flip face-up cards face-down
        if not droppedObject.is_face_down then
            droppedObject.flip()
        end
        -- Step 2: Move dropped object under deck
        droppedObject.setPositionSmooth(Vector(deckPos.x, 2, deckPos.z), false, true)


        Wait.time(function()
            -- Step 3: Move deck back down
            deck.setPositionSmooth(deckPos, false, true)

            -- Step 4: After short delay, unlock the deck
            Wait.time(function()
                deck.setLock(false)

                -- Step 5: Correct the name afterward
                Wait.time(function()
                    local newDeck = findPlayerDeckByName(player_color, "main")
                    if newDeck then
                        local name = newDeck.getName()
                        if not name:lower():find("main") then
                            newDeck.setName(name .. "main")
                        end
                    end
                end, 0.5)

            end, 0.6)

        end, 0.5)

    end, 0.5)

end

local function split_on_slash(name)
  local left, right = name:match("^(.-)%s*/%s*(.+)$")
  return left and trimSpaces(left) or trimSpaces(name), right and trimSpaces(right) or nil
end

function onPlayerAction(player, action, targets)
  if action ~= Player.Action.FlipOver then return end

  local fieldGUID = playerfields[player.color]
  if not fieldGUID then return end

  for _, obj in ipairs(targets) do
    if obj and obj.tag == "Card" then
      -- Is this card in the player's Field zone?
      local inField = false
      local zones = obj.getZones() or {}
      for _, z in ipairs(zones) do
        if z.guid == fieldGUID then inField = true; break end
      end
      if inField then
        -- Wait for the flip physics to settle
        Wait.condition(function()
          if not obj or obj.isDestroyed() then return end

          local lastIdx = getLastStateIndex(obj)

          -- On the first flip for double-faced cards: move into the final (multi-face) state
          if lastIdx and lastIdx > 1 and obj.getStateId() ~= lastIdx then
            waitToSwitchState(obj, lastIdx, function()
              -- tiny delay helps ensure name/state/description are all “live”
              Wait.time(function()
                if obj and not obj.isDestroyed() then
                  inscriptCardRulesText(obj)
                end
              end, 0.05)
            end)
          else
            -- Already in the final state (or single-face card): just inscript after flip settles
            Wait.time(function()
              if obj and not obj.isDestroyed() then
                inscriptCardRulesText(obj)
              end
            end, 0.05)
          end
        end, function()
          return obj and not obj.isDestroyed()
             and not obj.isSmoothMoving()
             and not obj.spawning
        end)
      end
    end
  end
end

  -- ---------- helpers ----------
  local function urlencode(s)
    return (tostring(s):gsub("\n", "\r\n"):gsub("([^%w _%-%.~])", function(c)

    end):gsub(" ", "%%20"))
  end

  local function clean(s)
    s = (s or ""):lower()
    s = s:gsub("[%p]", " "):gsub("%s+", " "):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    return s
  end

  -- rank: 1 exact, 2 startswith, 3 word-startswith, 4 contains, else 9
  local function rankName(name, q)
    local n, qn = clean(name), clean(q)
    if n == qn then return 1 end
    if n:sub(1, #qn) == qn then return 2 end
    for w in n:gmatch("%S+") do
      if w:sub(1, #qn) == qn then return 3 end
    end
    if n:find(qn, 1, true) then return 4 end
    return 9
  end

-- reduced tools slug from TITLE (left side of '/', slugified)
local function reducedSlugFromTitle(name)
  name = name or ""
  -- take only the left side before a slash (if any)
  local left = name:match("^(.-)%s*/%s*.+$") or name
  left = left:lower()

  -- handle possessives like "revenant’s" / "revenant's" → "revenants"
  left = left:gsub("['’]s", "s")

  -- drop leftover apostrophes/backticks (straight or curly)
  left = left:gsub("[‘’´`']", "")

  -- spaces → hyphen
  left = left:gsub("%s+", "-")

  -- turn any remaining non-alnum, non-hyphen chars into hyphen
  left = left:gsub("[^%w%-]+", "-")

  -- collapse multiple hyphens and trim edges
  left = left:gsub("%-+", "-"):gsub("^%-+", ""):gsub("%-+$", "")

  return left
end

local function spawnFromToolsSlug(slug, player)
    cardData = getCardData(slug)
    text = JSON.encode(cardData)
    local blob = '{"cards":{"spawn":[' .. text .. ']}}'
    local ok, deck = pcall(JSON.decode, blob)
    if ok and deck then
      Global.call("spawnDeckRemote", { json = deck, player = player })
    end
end
  -- cache of { {slug=..., name=...}, ... }
  Riftbound_NameIndex = Riftbound_NameIndex or nil

  local function buildRiftboundNameIndex()
      local lib = Riftbound_CardLibrary or Global.getVar("Riftbound_CardLibrary")
      if not lib then
          print("ERROR: Riftbound_CardLibrary not set on Global")
          return false
      end

      local ok, cardMap = pcall(lib.call, "getMap")
      if not ok or not cardMap then
          print("ERROR: getMap() failed on Riftbound_CardLibrary")
          return false
      end

      local index = {}
      for slug, data in pairs(cardMap) do
          table.insert(index, {
              slug = slug,
              name = (data and data.name) or ""
          })
      end

      Riftbound_NameIndex = index
      print("Riftbound name index built with " .. tostring(#index) .. " entries.")
      return true
  end

  function onChat(message, player)
      local m = message or ""
      if m:lower():sub(1,6) ~= "spawn " then return end

      local query = m:sub(7):gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","")
      if query == "" then
          Player[player.color].broadcast("Usage: spawn <card name>", {1,0.9,0})
          return false
      end

      -- ensure we have a name index
      if not Riftbound_NameIndex then
          if not buildRiftboundNameIndex() then
              Player[player.color].broadcast("Spawn not ready (library error).", {1,0.3,0.3})
              return false
          end
      end

      local bestEntry = nil
      local bestRank = nil

      for _, entry in ipairs(Riftbound_NameIndex) do
          local name = entry.name or ""
          if name ~= "" then
              local r = rankName(name, query)
              if not bestRank or r < bestRank or (r == bestRank and name < bestEntry.name) then
                  bestRank = r
                  bestEntry = entry
              end
          end
      end

      if not bestEntry then
          Player[player.color].broadcast("No results for: " .. query, {1,0.9,0})
          return false
      end

      local slug = bestEntry.slug
      local name = bestEntry.name or slug

      Player[player.color].broadcast("Spawning: " .. name .. " [" .. slug .. "]", {0.6,1,0.6})

      -- whatever your spawn target is – reusing your GA function name:
      spawnFromToolsSlug(slug, player)

      return false -- suppress chat echo
  end



function onPlayerChangeColor(player_color)
    Wait.time(function()
        resetCamera(player_color)
    end, 0.5) -- Delay allows default camera animation to complete
end

-- Saves core data on save triggers.
------------------------------------
function onSave()
  local data_to_save = {}
  data_to_save["cards"] = {}
  data_to_save["properties"] = {}
  data_to_save["zones"] = {}
  data_to_save["values"] = {}
  data_to_save["players"] = JSON.encode(Players)
  data_to_save["menus"] = {}

  for i,v in pairs(EncodedObjects) do
    --Removing Object reference before encoding.
    EncodedObjects[i].this = getObjectFromGUID(i)
    if EncodedObjects[i].this ~= nil then
      local tempThis = EncodedObjects[i].this
      EncodedObjects[i].this = ""
      data_to_save["cards"][i] = JSON.encode(EncodedObjects[i])
      EncodedObjects[i].this = tempThis
    end
  end
  for i,v in pairs(Zones) do
    if Zones[i].funcOwner ~= nil then
      local tempThis = Zones[i].funcOwner
      Zones[i].funcOwner = Zones[i].funcOwner.getGUID()
      data_to_save["zones"][i] = JSON.encode(Zones[i])
      Zones[i].funcOwner = tempThis
    end
  end
  for i,v in pairs(Properties) do
    --Removing Object reference before encoding.
    if Properties[i].funcOwner ~= nil then
      local tempThis = Properties[i].funcOwner
      Properties[i].funcOwner = Properties[i].funcOwner.getGUID()
      data_to_save["properties"][i] = JSON.encode(Properties[i])
      Properties[i].funcOwner = tempThis
    end
  end
  for i,v in pairs(Values) do
    local tempThis = Values[i].validate
    Values[i].validate = ''
    data_to_save["values"][i] = JSON.encode(Values[i])
    Values[i].validate = tempThis
  end
  for i,v in pairs(Menus) do
    if Menus[i].funcOwner ~= nil then
      local tempThis = Menus[i].funcOwner
      Menus[i].funcOwner = Menus[i].funcOwner.getGUID()
      data_to_save["menus"][i] = JSON.encode(Menus[i])
      Menus[i].funcOwner = tempThis
    end
  end
  saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
  return saved_data
end

-- Calls the version check for the encoder, and any modules
-- which support an update check.
function callVersionCheck()
  if CORE_VALUE.beta then
    WebRequest.get(URLS['ENCODER_BETA'],self,"versionCheck")
  else
    WebRequest.get(URLS['ENCODER'],self,"versionCheck")
  end
  for k,v in pairs(Properties) do
    u = v.funcOwner.getVar('UPDATE_URL')
    if u ~= nil then
      WebRequest.get(u,v.funcOwner,"updateModule")
    end
  end
  for k,v in pairs(Menus) do
    u = v.funcOwner.getVar('UPDATE_URL')
    if u ~= nil then
      WebRequest.get(u,v.funcOwner,"updateModule")
    end
  end
end

--The callVersionCheck callback for the encoder webrequest.
function versionCheck(wr)
  wr = wr.text
  local ver = versionComp(string.match(wr,"version = '(.-)'"),version)
  if ''..ver ~= ''..version then
    if CORE_VALUE.beta == true then
      broadcastToAll("An update has been found for the beta branch. Reloading encoder.")
    else
      broadcastToAll("An update has been found for the main branch. Reloading encoder.")
    end
    self.script_code = wr
    self.reload()
  else
    broadcastToAll("No update found at this time. Carry on.")
  end
end
--Compares two version strings of "(/d*.+)*"
--Examples: 1, 1.2, 0.1111.2, 0.0.0.0.1, 192.168.0.1
function versionComp(a,b)
  --First does the pattern only contain ([0-9]+)%.?
  --Pattern for versioning ##.##.##.##
  va = {}
  vb = {}
  for f in string.gmatch(a,'([0-9]+)%.?') do
    table.insert(va,tonumber(f))
  end
  for f in string.gmatch(b,'([0-9]+)%.?') do
    table.insert(vb,tonumber(f))
  end
  for k = 1, #va >= #vb and #va or #vb do
    if (va[k] ~= nil and va[k] or 0) > (vb[k] ~= nil and vb[k] or 0) then
      return a
    elseif (va[k] ~= nil and va[k] or 0) < (vb[k] ~= nil and vb[k] or 0) then
      return b
    end
  end
  return b
end

-- NEW- Registers each players hands as a zone for the encoder to track.
-- This is used to more reliably hide/reveal card buttons as it transitions zones.
function buildZones()
  local hands = {}
  local color = nil
  for k,v in pairs(Hands.getHands()) do
    --Hand Color
    color = v.getValue()
    --How many hands of this color have shown up. Init to 0 if nil.
    if hands[color] == nil then
      hands[color] = 0
    end
    hands[color] = hands[color]+1
    --Zone id is hand color + hand count for that color.
    id = color.."_"..hands[color]
    Zones[v.guid] = {
        name = id,
        func_enter = 'hideCardDetails',
        func_leave = 'showCardDetails',
        funcOwner = self,
        color = color}
  end
end
--Spawns in the default menu module if no menu module exists.
function getMenuModule(wr)
  local wr = wr.text
  params = {}

  params.rotation = self.getRotation()

      obj.setName('Menu Module')
      obj.script_code = wr
      obj.reload()
      Wait.condition(function() obj.call("registerModule",nil) end,function() return obj.spawning end)
    end
  spawnObject(params)
end

--Use a raycast to check if an object is resting in a hand or not.

--  impact during a raycast.

  if obj ~= nil and obj.getLock() == false and obj.held_by_color == nil then
    for k,v in pairs(obj.getZones()) do

    end

  return false

--Helper function for creating uniform button sizes.
function updateSize(text,font_size,max_len,x_just,y_just)
  local temp = ''..text
  local size = 0
  local depth = 0
  local old_i = 0
  local i = 0
  local fsize = font_size
  while old_i < #temp do
    i = string.find(temp,"\n",old_i)
    if i == nil then
      i = #temp
    end
    if i - old_i > size then
      size = i-old_i
    end
    old_i = i+1
    depth = depth+1
  end
  if size <= max_len then
    fsize = font_size
  else
    fsize = font_size*(max_len/size)
  end

  offset_x = x_just*(size/19+0.05)*-1--*(fsize/(150/86)))
  offset_y = 0--y_just*((depth/2*fsize)+8)
  barSize = size*((fsize/(150/83)))+20
  return barSize,fsize,offset_x,offset_y
end

--Calls the menus/property modules createButtons funciton
--  when updating a given object.
function buildButtons(o,h)
  if h == nil then
    h = handCheck(o)
  end
  if o==nil then return end
  if EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].disable ~= true then
    o.clearButtons()
    o.clearInputs()
    if EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].editing == nil then
      for k,v in pairs(Menus) do
        if v.funcOwner ~= nil then
          if EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].menus[k] == nil then
            EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].menus[k] = {open=false,pos=0}
          end
          if v.visible_in_hand == nil then
            v.visible_in_hand = 0
          end
          if h==true and v.visible_in_hand>=1 then
            v.funcOwner.call(v.activateFunc,{obj=o})
          elseif h~=true and v.visible_in_hand<=1 then
            v.funcOwner.call(v.activateFunc,{obj=o})
          end
        else
          --log(v.funcOwner,"Missing module for menu "..k,'missing_module')
        end
      end
      for k,v in pairs(EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].encoded) do
        if v == true and Properties[k]~=nil and Properties[k].funcOwner~= nil then
          if Properties[k].visible_in_hand == nil then
            Properties[k].visible_in_hand = 0
          end
          if h==true and Properties[k].visible_in_hand>=1 then
            Properties[k].funcOwner.call("createButtons",{obj=o})
          elseif h~=true and Properties[k].visible_in_hand<=1 then
            Properties[k].funcOwner.call("createButtons",{obj=o})
          end
        end
      end
    else
      k = EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].editing
      if Properties[k]~=nil and Properties[k].funcOwner~= nil then
        Properties[k].funcOwner.call("createButtons",{obj=o})
      end
      flip = EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].flip
      temp = " X "
      barSize,fsize,offset_x,offset_y = updateSize(temp,90,90,0,0)
      ob = {
      label=temp, click_function='closeEditor', function_owner=self,
      position={(-1.1+offset_x)*flip,0.28*flip,(1.4+offset_y)}, height=100, width=barSize, font_size=fsize,
      rotation={0,0,90-90*flip}
      }
      for k,v in pairs(APIgetStyleTable()) do
        if ob[k] == nil then
          ob[k] = v
        end
      end
      o.createButton(ob)
    end
  end
end

  if type(o) == 'String' then
    Players[o].editing = nil
  else
    EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].editing = nil
  end
  buildButtons(o)

--Disables encoding of a card.
function disableEncoding(o,p)
  EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].disable = true
  o.setName(EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].oName)
  local selection =Player[p].getSelectedObjects()
  if selection ~= nil then
    for k,v in pairs(selection) do
      if EncodedObjects[v.getGUID()] ~= nil and v ~= o then
        EncodedObjects[v.getGUID()].disable = true
        v.setName(EncodedObjects[v.getGUID()].oName)
        v.clearButtons()
        v.clearInputs()
        buildButtons(v)
      end
    end
  end
  o.clearButtons()
  o.clearInputs()
  buildButtons(o)
end
--Flips the menu for the front face to the backface and reverse.
function flipMenu(o,p)
  local flip = EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].flip
  if flip ~= 1 then
    EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].flip = 1
		o.hide_when_face_down = true
  else
    EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].flip = -1
		o.hide_when_face_down = false
  end
  if type(p) == "string" then
    local selection =Player[p].getSelectedObjects()
    if selection ~= nil then
      for k,v in pairs(selection) do
        if EncodedObjects[v.getGUID()] ~= nil and v ~= o then
          flipMenu(v,0)
        end
      end
    end
  end
  buildButtons(o)
end
--Turn target property on or off, calling the relevant Module functions.
function toggleProperty(o,p)
  if EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()] ~= nil then
    local prop = EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].encoded[p]
    if prop == nil then
      EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].encoded[p] = true
    else
      if prop ~= true then
        EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].encoded[p] = true
      else
        EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].encoded[p] = false
      end
    end
    for k,v in pairs(Properties[p].values) do
      if Values[v] ~= nil and EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].values[v] == nil then
        EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].values[v] = Values[v].default
      end
    end
    return EncodedObjects[o.getGUID()].encoded[p]
  elseif type(o) == 'String' and Players[o] ~= nil then
    local prop = Players[o].encoded[p]
    if prop == nil then
      Players[o].encoded[p] = true
    else
      if prop ~= true then
        Players[o].encoded[p] = true
      else
        Players[o].encoded[p] = false
      end
    end
    for k,v in pairs(Properties[p].values) do
      if Values[v] ~= nil and Players[o].values[v] == nil then
        Players[o].values[v] = Values[v].default
      end
    end
    return Players[o].encoded[p]
  end
end


-- Factories
function buildValueValidationFunction(p)
  v=Values[p]
  if v.validType ~= nil and v.validType ~= 'nil' then
    if string.find('stringnumberboolean',v.validType) then
      local vt = v.validType
      Values[p]['validate']= function(val,cur)
        if type(val) == vt then return val else return cur end end
    elseif string.find(v.validType, 'pattern%b()') then
      local _,_,pat = string.find(v.validType,'pattern(%b())')
      if #pat > 2 then
        pat = string.sub(pat,2,-2)
        Values[p]['validate']= function(val,cur)
        if string.find(val,pat) then return val else return cur end end
      end
    elseif string.find(v.validType, 'color') then
      Values[p]['validate']= function(val,cur)
      if val == '' or val == nil or Player[val] ~= nil then return val else return cur end end
    end
  else
    Values[p]['validate']= function(val,cur) return val end
  end
  _G[p..'Validate']= Values[p]['validate']
end

--Lists currently registered properties.
function APIgetPropsList(p)
  tags = {}
  if p ~= nil and p.tags ~= nil then
    for k,v in pairs(p.tags) do
      tags[k] = v
    end
  end
  data = {}
  for k,v in pairs(Properties) do
    if #tags ~= 0 then
      if v.tags == nil or v.tags == '' then
        Properties[k].tags = 'untagged'
      end
      for i=1, #tags do
        if string.find(v.tags,tags[i]) then
          if v.funcOwner == nil then
            data[k]='[Red]MISSING![White]'
          else
            data[k]=''
          end
          data[k]=data[k]..v.propID.." : "..v.name.." {"
          for m,n in pairs(v.values) do
            data[k]=data[k]..n..","
          end
          data[k]=data[k].."}"
          break;
        end
      end
    else
      if v.funcOwner == nil then
        data[k]='[Red]MISSING![White]'
      else
        data[k]=''
      end
      data[k]=data[k]..v.propID.." : "..v.name.." {"
      for m,n in pairs(v.values) do
        data[k]=data[k]..n..","
      end
      data[k]=data[k].."}"
    end
  end
  return data
end

-- Tool Functions
function deepcopy(orig)
    local orig_type = type(orig)
    local copy
    if orig_type == 'table' then
        copy = {}
        for orig_key, orig_value in next, orig, nil do
            copy[deepcopy(orig_key)] = deepcopy(orig_value)
        end
        setmetatable(copy, deepcopy(getmetatable(orig)))
    else -- number, string, boolean, etc
        copy = orig
    end
    return copy
end

function garbageCollect()
  for k,v in pairs(EncodedObjects) do

    end

  for k,v in pairs(Properties) do

      Properties[k] = nil
    end
  end
  for k,v in pairs(Zones) do
    if v.funcOwner == nil then
      Zones[k] = nil
    end
  end
  for k,v in pairs(Menus) do
    if v.funcOwner == nil then
      Menus[k] = nil
    end
  end
end
