pID = "πGlimpse"
version = 3.14159

function onload()
  self.createButton({
    click_function='registerModule', function_owner=self, label='[i]'..pID..'[/i]', tooltip='register '..pID,
    position={0,0.1,0}, rotation={0,0,0}, scale={0.5,1,0.5},
    height=250, width=700, font_size=150,  color={0.1,0.1,0.1,1}, font_color={1,1,1,1},
  })
  Wait.condition(registerModule,function() return Global.getVar('Encoder') ~= nil and true or false end)
end

function registerModule()
  enc = Global.getVar('Encoder')
  tableGUIDs = Global.getTable('data')
  if enc ~= nil then
		properties = {
      propID = pID,
      name = "Scry Module",
      values = {},
      funcOwner = self,
      tags="tool,table_tool",
      activateFunc ='toggleProp',
      visible=false,
      visible_in_hand=2
		}
		enc.call("APIregisterProperty",properties)
  end
end

function toggleProp(obj,ply)
  enc.call("APItoggleProperty",{obj=obj,propID=pID})
  enc.call("APIrebuildButtons",{obj=obj})
end

-- disable scry buttons when leaving hand 2
 function onObjectLeaveZone(zone,obj)
   if obj==nil then return end --wtf? how can this happen? but it does
   if obj.type~="Card" then return end
   enc = Global.getVar('Encoder')
   if enc then
     Zones=enc.call("APIlistZones",{})
     encZone=Zones[zone.getGUID()]
     if encZone then
       isHand2=encZone.name:find('Hand 2')
       if isHand2 then
         -- using GMnotes as a scry-zone flag (in case the object is just passing through the scry zone)
         if obj.getGMNotes()=='scryEnter' then obj.setGMNotes('') end
         -- check that the object is encoded
         if not(enc.call("APIobjectExists",{obj=obj})) then return end
         -- if encoded and scry is enabled, disable it
         if enc.call("APIobjIsPropEnabled",{obj=obj,propID=pID}) then
           enc.call("APIobjDisableProp",{obj=obj,propID=pID})
         end
       end
     end
   end
 end

function onObjectDestroy(obj)
  pcall(function()
    if obj==nil then return end --wtf? how can this happen? but it does
    enc = Global.getVar('Encoder')
    if obj.type~="Card" or enc==nil then return end
    if enc.call("APIobjIsPropEnabled",{obj=obj,propID=pID}) then
      enc.call("APIobjDisableProp",{obj=obj,propID=pID})
    end
  end)
end

-- disable scry if the card lands on the table (height < 2)
function onObjectDrop(ply,obj)
  if obj==nil then return end --wtf? how can this happen? but it does
  if obj.type~="Card" then return end
  enc = Global.getVar('Encoder')
  if enc==nil then return end
  if not(enc.call("APIobjIsPropEnabled",{obj=obj,propID=pID})) then return end

  local inHand2=false
  if obj==nil then return end
  for _,col in pairs(Player.getAvailableColors()) do
    local handObjs=Player[col].getHandObjects(2)
    for _,handObj in pairs(handObjs) do
      if obj==handObj then
        inHand2=true
      end
    end
  end
  if not inHand2 then
    enc.call("APIobjDisableProp",{obj=obj,propID=pID})
    enc.call("APIrebuildButtons",{obj=obj})
  end
end

    label='', tooltip='', click_function = 'null', function_owner = self,

    color = {0.7,0.7,0.7}, font_color = {1, 1, 1},
  }

    label='', tooltip='', click_function = 'null', function_owner = self,
    position = {0, 0, 0}, width = 500, height = 400, font_size = 250,
    scale = {1.2,1.2,1.2}, rotation = {0,0,0},
    color = {0.16,0.16,0.16}, font_color = {1, 1, 1, 1}, hover_color = {0.4,0.4,0.4}
  }

  local lab='▲'
  local tip='to top deck'
  local fun='move2TopLib'
  local pos={-0.4, 0.1, -3}
  forgpars.label=lab
  forgpars.tooltip=tip
  forgpars.click_function=fun

  backpars.position=pos
  card.createButton(backpars)

  local lab='▼'
  local tip='to bottom deck'

  local pos={-0.4, 0.1, -2}
  forgpars.label=lab
  forgpars.tooltip=tip
  forgpars.click_function=fun
  forgpars.position=pos
  backpars.position=pos
  card.createButton(backpars)
  card.createButton(forgpars)

  local lab='☠'
  local tip='move to graveyard'
  local fun='move2Grav'
  local pos={-0.4, 0.1, 2}
  forgpars.label=lab
  forgpars.tooltip=tip
  forgpars.click_function=fun
  forgpars.position=pos
  backpars.position=pos
  card.createButton(backpars)
  card.createButton(forgpars)
    print(card)
end

function move2Lib(card, playerColor, alt)
  if not(alt) then
    move2TopLib(card,playerColor)
  else
    move2BotLib(card,playerColor)
  end
end

function move2TopLib(card, playerColor)
  enc = Global.getVar('Encoder')
  enc.call("APIobjDisableProp",{obj=card,propID=pID})
  local deck = Global.call("findPlayerDeckByNameRemote", { playerColor, "main" })
  local deckPos = deck.getPosition()
  local target = {x=deckPos.x, y=deckPos.y+3, z=deckPos.z}    -- above deck
  card.clearButtons()
  card.setHiddenFrom(allBut(playerColor))
  Wait.time(function() unhide(card) end, 0.2)
  local cardRot = card.getRotation()
  cardRot.z = 180
  card.setRotationSmooth(cardRot,false,true)
  Wait.time(function() handTrigger(card) card.setPositionSmooth(target,false,true) end, 0.2)
  Wait.time(function() checkMoveSuccess(card,target,playerColor) end, 0.5)

  selected = Player[playerColor].getSelectedObjects()
  for i,obj in ipairs(shuffleList(selected)) do
    if enc.call("APIobjIsPropEnabled",{obj=obj,propID=pID}) then
      Wait.frames(function() move2TopLib(obj, playerColor) end,i)
    end
  end
  Player[playerColor].clearSelectedObjects()

end

function move2BotLib(card, playerColor)
  enc = Global.getVar('Encoder')
  enc.call("APIobjDisableProp",{obj=card,propID=pID})
  local deck = Global.call("findPlayerDeckByNameRemote", { playerColor, "main" })
  local deckPos = deck.getPosition()
  local target  = {x=deckPos.x, y=1.1, z=deckPos.z}
  card.clearButtons()
  card.setHiddenFrom(allBut(playerColor))
  Wait.time(function() unhide(card) end, 0.2)
  local cardRot = card.getRotation()
  cardRot.z = 180
  card.setRotationSmooth(cardRot,false,true)
  Wait.time(function() handTrigger(card) card.setPositionSmooth(target,false,true) end, 0.2)
  Wait.time(function() checkMoveSuccess(card,target,playerColor) end, 0.5)

  selected = Player[playerColor].getSelectedObjects()
  for i,obj in ipairs(shuffleList(selected)) do
    if enc.call("APIobjIsPropEnabled",{obj=obj,propID=pID}) then
      Wait.frames(function() move2BotLib(obj, playerColor) end, i)
    end
  end
  Player[playerColor].clearSelectedObjects()
end

function move2Grav(card, playerColor)
  enc = Global.getVar('Encoder')
  enc.call("APIobjDisableProp",{obj=card,propID=pID})
  local gravPos = Global.call("findPlayerZoneByNameRemote", { playerColor, "graveyard" })
  local target  = {x=gravPos.x, y=3, z=gravPos.z}
  card.clearButtons()
  local cardRot = card.getRotation()
  cardRot.z = 0
  card.setRotationSmooth(cardRot,false,true)
  Wait.time(function() handTrigger(card) card.setPositionSmooth(target,false,true) end, 0.2)
  Wait.time(function() checkMoveSuccess(card,target,playerColor) end, 0.5)

  selected = Player[playerColor].getSelectedObjects()
  for i,obj in ipairs(shuffleList(selected)) do
    if enc.call("APIobjIsPropEnabled",{obj=obj,propID=pID}) then
      Wait.frames(function() move2Grav(obj, playerColor) end, i)
    end
  end
  Player[playerColor].clearSelectedObjects()
end

function shuffleList(list)
  math.randomseed(os.time())
	for i = #list, 2, -1 do
		local j = math.random(i)
		list[i], list[j] = list[j], list[i]
	end
  return list
end

-- for hiding cards
function allBut(playerColor)
  local players = {}
  for key, color in pairs(Color.list) do
    if color ~= playerColor then
      table.insert(players,color)
    end
  end
  return players
end
function unhide(card,nframes)
  if card~=nil then
    card.setHiddenFrom({})
  end
end

-- when returning cards from the scry-zone, turn off hand-zone's pull briefly
function handTrigger(obj)
  if obj~=nil then
    obj.use_hands=false
    Wait.time(function() handOn(obj) end, 0.1)
  end
end
function handOn(obj)
  if obj~=nil then
    obj.use_hands=true
  end
end

-- check that the card made it to it's target, if not, teleport it
function checkMoveSuccess(card,targetPos,playerColor)
  if card==nil then return end   -- the card is gone, probably stacked into a deck already
  -- use hands orientation to determine which coordinate to use to check position
  -- currently only set up to work with hands rotated 0,90,180,270 degrees
  local handForw=Player[playerColor].getHandTransform(2).forward
  local posDiff = 0
  if math.abs(handForw.z)>0.5 then
    posDiff = math.abs(card.getPosition().z - targetPos.z)
  elseif math.abs(handForw.x)>0.5 then
    posDiff = math.abs(card.getPosition().x - targetPos.x)
  end
  if posDiff>1 then
    card.setPosition(targetPos)
  end
end

-- Get real string width as per char table
function GetStringWidth(str)
    local len = 0
    for i = 1, #str do
        local c = str:sub(i,i)
        len = len + (charWidth[c] or charWidth.avg)
    end
    return len
end

-- Get real string width as per char table
function findStringLength(str)
    local len = 0
    local k=0
    for i = 1, #str do
        local c = str:sub(i,i)
        len = len + (charWidth[c] or charWidth.avg)

-- Over-engineered method to convert input string to button string
-- inserting line-breaks whenever the width of a line exceeds the box
maxWidth=59837    -- found by trial and error
maxNlines=9
function insertBreaks(str)

  -- first, split the str by any existing line-breaks
  local strTable={}
  local brInd=nil
  while str:find('\n') do
    brInd=str:find('\n')
    table.insert(strTable,str:sub(1,brInd))
    str=str:sub(brInd+1,-1)
  end
  table.insert(strTable,str)

  -- split each string further by maxWidth
  local strTable2={}
  local nLines = 0
  for _,str in ipairs(strTable) do

    str=str:gsub('[\n]','')    -- remove \n, it'll get reinserted with table.concat

    local len = 0
    local stInd = 1
    local enInd = nil
    local parsing = true
    local i=0

    while parsing do

      i=i+1
      local c = str:sub(i,i)
      if c==' ' then enInd=i end  -- save last encoutered space ind
      prevLen = len
      len = len + (charWidth[c] or charWidth.avg)

      if i>=#str and len<=maxWidth then   -- reached the end of string
        local snip=str:sub(stInd,i)
        table.insert(strTable2,snip)
        nLines=nLines+1
        parsing = false
        break
      end

      if len>maxWidth then   -- maxWidth reached
        if enInd then        -- a space was found
          local snip = str:sub(stInd,enInd-1)
          table.insert(strTable2,snip)
          nLines=nLines+1
          len=0
          stInd=enInd+1
          i=enInd
          enInd=nil
        else                 -- a long sequence of characters without space
          local snip = str:sub(stInd,i-1)
          table.insert(strTable2,snip)
          nLines=nLines+1
          len=0
          stInd=i
          i=i-1
          enInd=nil
        end

        if i>=#str then
          parsing = false
        end

      end

      if nLines>maxNlines then    -- max number of lines reached
        parsing=false
      end

    end
  end

  while nLines<maxNlines do       -- fill up the rest of the lines
    nLines=nLines+1
    table.insert(strTable2,' ')
  end

  return table.concat(strTable2,'\n')

end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This tool makes sure all players (present and future) are promoted so they have "host" powers: delete/spawn/copy/paste/etc.

The tool also takes care that deliberately demoted players are never automatically promoted again (such as if they drop & rejoin or if time is rewound).

You'll probably want to hide this underneath the table, disable tooltip, and disable interactivity (see script).
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
--::[[ Auto Player Promoter ]]::--
-- Version 1.0
-- By Kevin O'Mara (Quickle)
-- https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561197997376704

--[[
This script runs in the background and makes sure all players are promoted so
they have "host" powers (delete/spawn/copy/paste/etc.) For more info on host:
http://berserk-games.com/knowledgebase/player-roles/

Additionally, if a player gets "demoted", the script takes care they are never
automatically promoted again (i.e. when the player drops and re-joins the match,
the game is saved and loaded in the future, or time is rewound/fast forwarded).

Players are promoted at the following times:
* All players are promoted each time the game first loads (including Undo/Redo).
* New players are promoted upon joining the match.

Whether a player is "demoted" is recorded at the following times:
* All players are recorded when the game saves (including auto saves).
* Individual players are recorded when they leave the match.

Undo / Redo
* Undo - A demoted player may become promoted again if time rewinds to a point
  when they were previously promoted.
* Redo - A player will never become demoted when time fast forwards, even if
  they had previously been demoted at that autosave.
--]]



--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--[[ CONFIGURATION  ]]----------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--[[
You can modify the script's behavior by changing these variables:
--]]

-- When true, this object is interactable by Players.
-- You may wish to lock this object and hide it somewhere. To do so, simply:
--  1. Set this value to 'true' & save the script.
--  2. Move the object somewhere & save the game.
--  3. Set this value back to 'false' & save the script.
local objectIsInteractable = true

-- When true, a chat message announces each time a player is automatically
-- promoted or would have been promoted (but wasn't because they are "demoted").
-- Lets players know they are being promoted by a script rather than the host.
local chatEnabled = false

-- When true, debug information is written the log window (host only).
local loggingEnabled = false


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--[[ SCRIPT CODE  ]]------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--[[ Utility Methods ]]---------------------------------------------------------

local function _log(element, label)
    -- Log a message with the prefix "AutoPlayerPromoter: ".
    -- Wrapper for `log()`: https://api.tabletopsimulator.com/base/#log
    if loggingEnabled then
        log(element, "AutoPlayerPromoter: " .. tostring(label))
    end
end

local function _printToAll(message)
    -- Print a message to chat, but only if `chatEnabled` is `true`.
    -- Wrapper for `print()`: https://api.tabletopsimulator.com/base/#print
    if chatEnabled then
        printToAll(message)
    end
end

local function _playerAsTable(player)
    -- Return a <Player> object (https://api.tabletopsimulator.com/player/) as a
    -- simple key-value table, which can be expanded by the built-in logging
    -- method: https://api.tabletopsimulator.com/base/#log
    return {
        steam_name  = player.steam_name,
        steam_id    = player.steam_id,
        promoted    = player.promoted,
        host        = player.host,
        admin       = player.admin,
        color       = player.color,
        team        = player.team,
        seated      = player.seated,
        blindfolded = player.blindfolded,
        lift_height = player.lift_height,
    }
end
--//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////



--[[ Player Promotion Tracker ]]------------------------------------------------
--[[
Keeps track of which players are demoted and offers a method to promote players.
--]]

-- Steam IDs of Players who have had their promotion revoked.
-- @type: Set<string>
local _demotedPlayerSteamIds = {}

function isOnDemotedPlayerList(player)
    -- @param player <Player> (https://api.tabletopsimulator.com/player/)
    return _demotedPlayerSteamIds[player.steam_id] ~= nil
end

function isPromoted(player)
    -- @param player <Player> (https://api.tabletopsimulator.com/player/)
    return player.promoted or player.host
end

function tryPromotePlayer(player)
    -- @param player <Player> (https://api.tabletopsimulator.com/player/)
    if isOnDemotedPlayerList(player) then
        _log(_playerAsTable(player), "Will not promote player because they are on the Demoted Player List: ")
        _printToAll("AutoPlayerPromoter: Not promoting player " .. tostring(player.steam_name) .. ", because they were demoted by host.")
    elseif isPromoted(player) then
        _log(_playerAsTable(player), "Will not promote player because they are already promoted or host: ")
    else
        _log(_playerAsTable(player), "Promoting player: ")
        _printToAll("AutoPlayerPromoter: Promoting " .. tostring(player.steam_name))
        player.promote()
    end
end

function savePlayerPromotionState(player)
    -- @param player <Player> (https://api.tabletopsimulator.com/player/)
    if isPromoted(player) then
        _log(_playerAsTable(player), "Saving player's promotion status. Player is <promoted>: ")
        _demotedPlayerSteamIds[player.steam_id] = nil
    else
        _log(_playerAsTable(player), "Saving player's promotion status. Player is <demoted>: ")
        _demotedPlayerSteamIds[player.steam_id] = {}
    end
end
--//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////



--[[ Event Hooks ]]-------------------------------------------------------------
--[[
Makes sure players are getting promoted and recorded at the right times by
responding to events.
--]]

function onLoad(saveData)
    self.interactable = objectIsInteractable

    _log(saveData, "Loading from script state: ")
    if saveData == "" then
        _demotedPlayerSteamIds = {}
    else
        _demotedPlayerSteamIds = JSON.decode(saveData)
    end

    local players = Player.getPlayers()
    for _, player in ipairs(players) do
        tryPromotePlayer(player)
    end
end

function onPlayerConnect(player)
    -- @param player <Player> (https://api.tabletopsimulator.com/player/)
    tryPromotePlayer(player)
end

function onPlayerDisconnect(player)
    -- @param player <Player> (https://api.tabletopsimulator.com/player/)
    savePlayerPromotionState(player)
end

function onSave()
    local players = Player.getPlayers()
    for _, player in ipairs(players) do
        savePlayerPromotionState(player)
    end

    saveData = JSON.encode(_demotedPlayerSteamIds)
    _log(saveData, "Saving script state: ")
    return saveData
end

function suppress(obj,ply)

  if enc ~= nil then

    data = enc.call("APIobjGetPropData",{obj=obj,propID=pID})
		if data.ga_suppressed ~= true then
			data.ga_suppressed = true
    else

    enc.call("APIobjSetPropData",{obj=obj,propID=pID,data=data})
    enc.call("APIrebuildButtons",{obj=obj})

  if enc ~= nil and enc.call("APIobjectExists",{obj=obj}) then
    flip = enc.call("APIgetFlip",{obj=obj})

		data = enc.call("APIobjGetPropData",{obj=obj,propID=pID})
		if data.ga_suppressed == true then
			data.ga_suppressed = false
			enc.call("APIobjSetPropData",{obj=obj,propID=pID,data=data})
      enc.call("APIobjDisableProp",{obj=obj,propID=pID})
		end
		if type(ply) == "string" then
			local selection =Player[ply].getSelectedObjects()
			if selection ~= nil then
				for k,v in pairs(selection) do
					if v ~= tar and enc.call("APIobjectExists",{obj=v}) == true then
						unsuppress(v,0)
					end
				end
			end
		end
    enc.call("APIrebuildButtons",{obj=obj})
  end
end
function updateModule(wr)
  enc = Global.getVar('Encoder')
  if enc ~= nil then
    wr = wr.text
    wrv = string.match(wr,"version = '(.-)'")
    if wrv == 'DEPRECIATED' then
      enc.call("APIremoveProperty",{propID=pID})
      self.destruct()
    end
    local ver = enc.call("APIversionComp",{wv=wrv,cv=version})
    if ''..ver ~= ''..version then
      broadcastToAll("An update has been found for "..pID..". Reloading Module.")
      self.script_code = wr
      self.reload()
    else
      broadcastToAll("No update found for "..pID..". Carry on.")
    end
  end
end

cachedReferences = {}

local function getVisibleDeckEntry(deck)
  local list = deck.getObjects() or {}
  if #list == 0 then return nil end

  local pick, maxIndex = list[1], (list[1].index or -1)
  for _, e in ipairs(list) do
    local idx = e.index or -1
    if idx > maxIndex then
      pick, maxIndex = e, idx
    end
  end
  return pick or list[#list]
end


local function subjectCardName(obj)
  if not obj then return nil end
  if obj.tag == "Card" then
    return obj.getName()
  elseif obj.tag == "Deck" then
    local entry = getVisibleDeckEntry(obj)
    if entry then
      -- entry.nickname is usually the printed title; fall back to name
      return entry.nickname or entry.name
    end
  end
  return nil
end

    local enc = Global.getVar('Encoder')
    local name = subjectCardName(obj)
    if is_random then
      print ("Spawning Random Reference for " .. name)
    else
      print ("Spawning References for " .. name)
    end
    local slug = name:lower():gsub(" ", "-"):gsub("'", ""):gsub(",", "")

    if cachedReferences[slug] != nil then
      summonCachedReferences(obj, ply, slug, is_random)
    elseif enc ~= nil then
        if is_random then
          -- temp hack because index doesn't have all the gather references
          cachedReferences[slug] = temp_gather_hack_json
          summonCachedReferences(obj, ply, slug, is_random)
        else
          local url = "https://api.gatcg.com/cards/" .. slug
          WebRequest.get(url, function(response)
              if response.is_error then
                log(response.error)
              else
                  local jsonData = JSON.decode(response.text)
                  cachedReferences[slug] = jsonData.references
                  summonCachedReferences(obj, ply, slug, is_random)
              end
          end)
        end
    else

    end

    end

  local count = 0
  for _ in pairs(T) do count = count + 1 end
  return count

  end

PLAYMAT = getObjectFromGUID("fa1d96")
ZONE = getObjectFromGUID("ead6cb")
DEFAULT = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/17072502246278371407/BE3E821A508C48E22CDA5CE79E392959FAF7393A/"
SCALE = 0.80

-- Variable to track the card that set the playmat
currentCard = nil

function onObjectLeaveZone(zone, object)
    if zone.guid == self.guid then
        local json = JSON.decode(object.getGMNotes())
        if json and json.type and json.type == "battlefield" then

            -- Only reset the playmat if the card leaving is the one that set it
            if currentCard == object then
                currentCard = nil

                -- Check if there are any remaining battlefield cards in the zone
                local objects = ZONE.getObjects()
                local hasBattlefieldCard = false
                for _, obj in ipairs(objects) do
                    local objJson = JSON.decode(obj.getGMNotes())
                    if objJson and objJson.type and objJson.type == "battlefield" then
                        hasBattlefieldCard = true
                        break
                    end
                end

                -- Reset the playmat to the default image if no battlefield cards remain
                if not hasBattlefieldCard then
                    local custom = PLAYMAT.getCustomObject()
                    custom.image = DEFAULT
                    PLAYMAT.setCustomObject(custom)
                    PLAYMAT = PLAYMAT.reload()
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function onObjectEnterScriptingZone(player_color, object)
    Wait.time(function()
    for _, v in ipairs(object.getZones()) do
        if v.guid == self.guid then
            -- Ensure the card is not face down before proceeding
            if object.is_face_down then
                return
            end

            local json = JSON.decode(object.getGMNotes())
            if json and json.type and json.type == "battlefield" then
                -- Ignore the card if the playmat is already set by another card
                if currentCard == nil then
                    currentCard = object

                    local position = PLAYMAT.getBoundsNormalized().center
                    position.y = 1
                    --object.setScale({SCALE, SCALE, SCALE})

                    local custom = PLAYMAT.getCustomObject()
                    custom.image = json.battlefield_image
                    PLAYMAT.setCustomObject(custom)
                    PLAYMAT = PLAYMAT.reload()
                end
            end
        end
    end
end, 1) -- Delay of 0.1 seconds to ensure the object is fully in the zone
end

-- Token Zone Spawner with Might Counter
CARD_SCALE = 1.3
SPAWN_OFFSET_Y = 0.2 -- Height offset for spawned tokens
CARD_SIZE = 4.2
ICON_URL = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/9257794450975868483/676E45F977E7D9200D25263512D57E2C97BA9176/"
TYPES = {unit = true, champion = true}  -- Card types we want to handle

-- State data (persists across save/load)
buffCounts = {}  -- Stores the buff count for each card GUID
lastAction = {}  -- Tracks whether last action was increase or decrease for color effect
deckCounts = {}  -- Stores the card count for each deck GUID
deckOrientations = {}  -- Stores the face orientation for each deck GUID
originalMightValues = {}  -- Stores the original might value for each card GUID
cardAttachments = {}  -- Stores attachments for each card GUID {cardGuid = {attachmentType = count}}
dropdownStates = {}  -- Tracks which cards have dropdown menus open

function onLoad(saved_data)
    -- Initialize or load saved data
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loadedData = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        if loadedData.buffCounts then
            buffCounts = loadedData.buffCounts
        end
        if loadedData.lastAction then
            lastAction = loadedData.lastAction
        end
        if loadedData.deckCounts then
            deckCounts = loadedData.deckCounts
        end
        if loadedData.deckOrientations then
            deckOrientations = loadedData.deckOrientations
        end
        if loadedData.originalMightValues then
            originalMightValues = loadedData.originalMightValues
        end
        if loadedData.cardAttachments then
            cardAttachments = loadedData.cardAttachments
        end
        if loadedData.dropdownStates then
            dropdownStates = loadedData.dropdownStates
        end
    end

    Wait.time(function()
        refreshButtons()
    end, 0.5)
end

function onSave()
    -- Save the buff counts and deck counts when game is saved
    return JSON.encode({
        buffCounts = buffCounts,
        lastAction = lastAction,
        deckCounts = deckCounts,
        deckOrientations = deckOrientations,
        originalMightValues = originalMightValues,
        cardAttachments = cardAttachments,
        dropdownStates = dropdownStates
    })
end

function buttonPress()
    -- Get all objects in the GENERATOR zone
    local objects_in_generator = GENERATOR.getObjects()
    for _, object in ipairs(objects_in_generator) do
        -- Check if the object has GM notes
        local gm_notes = object.getGMNotes()

        if gm_notes and gm_notes ~= "" then
            -- Attempt to decode the GM notes as JSON
            local success, json = pcall(function() return JSON.decode(gm_notes) end)

            if success and json and json.token and json.token ~= "" then
                local quantity = tonumber(json.quantity) or 1 -- Default to 1 if quantity is not provided
                -- Spawn the specified number of copies of the token
                for i = 1, quantity do
                    spawnObjectByToken(json.token)
                end
                return -- Exit after spawning the first valid token
            end
        end
    end
end

function spawnToken(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    local card = obj

    -- Check if object is a card before proceeding
    if card.type ~= "Card" then
        return
    end

    -- Check if the card has token information in GMNotes
    local gm_notes = card.getGMNotes()
    if not gm_notes or gm_notes == "" then
        return
    end

    -- Try to parse the GM notes as JSON
    local success, json = pcall(function() return JSON.decode(gm_notes) end)

    -- If JSON parsing succeeded and it contains a token field
    if success and json and json.token and json.token ~= "" then
        local tokenType = json.token
        local tokenQuantity = tonumber(json.quantity) or 1

        -- Get card position to spawn token next to it
        local cardPos = card.getPosition()
        local cardRot = card.getRotation() -- Get the rotation of the original card

        -- Broadcast message about the spawned token
        broadcastToAll(player_color .. " player spawned " .. tokenQuantity .. "x " .. tokenType, {r=0, g=0.8, b=1})

        -- Spawn the specified number of tokens
        for i = 1, tokenQuantity do
            local offset = i * 3.0 -- Space tokens out
            local spawn_position = {
                x = cardPos.x + offset,
                y = cardPos.y + SPAWN_OFFSET_Y,
                z = cardPos.z
            }

            spawnObjectByToken(tokenType, spawn_position, cardRot)
        end
    end
end

function spawnObjectByToken(token, spawn_position, card_rotation)
    -- Define custom objects with dynamic properties
    local custom_objects = {
        Recruit = {
            face = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/10175134908598210558/F95FDC902B598C90B1EB33A8D12F62C8C027B2A0/",
            back = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/40065918639591701/126653BC8C19063AE61162AC4A13B52E24AF3E1B/",
            name = "Recruit",
            type = "unit",
            isToken = true,
            might = 1,
            description = "We are the future."
        },

            back = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/40065918639591701/126653BC8C19063AE61162AC4A13B52E24AF3E1B/",
            name = "Recruit",
            type = "unit",

        },

            back = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/40065918639591701/126653BC8C19063AE61162AC4A13B52E24AF3E1B/",
            name = "Recruit",
            type = "unit",
            isToken = true,

        },

            face = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/16240015693053349633/CBA9F2F14867D2FC72ED92D2BFA3E359C863E2B3/",
            back = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/40065918639591701/126653BC8C19063AE61162AC4A13B52E24AF3E1B/",
            name = "sprite",
            type = "unit",
            isToken = true,
            might = 3,
            description = "Temporary:"
        },
        Buff = {
            face = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/10733003420101246799/B6540E3BCA36A9D05B85D0944C13BF8EF5A4C5B1/",
            back = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/40065918639591701/126653BC8C19063AE61162AC4A13B52E24AF3E1B/",
            name = "buff",
            type = "spell",
            isToken = false,

        }
    }

    local custom_object = custom_objects[token]
    if not custom_object then
        return
    end

    -- Use passed rotation if provided, otherwise default to {0, 180, 0}
    local rotation = card_rotation or {0, 180, 0}

    spawnObject({
        type = "Card",
        position = spawn_position,
        rotation = rotation,
        callback_function = function(obj)
            obj.setCustomObject({
                face = custom_object.face,
                back = custom_object.back,
                width = 1,
                height = 1,
                number = 2
            })
            obj.setScale({1, 1, 1}) -- Set the scale of the card
            obj.setName(custom_object.name) -- Dynamically set the name
            obj.setDescription(custom_object.description) -- Dynamically set the description
            -- Add GM notes to the spawned card
            obj.setGMNotes(JSON.encode({
                might = custom_object.might, -- Dynamically set might
                isToken = custom_object.isToken, -- Dynamically set isToken
                type = custom_object.type -- Dynamically set type
            }))
        end
    })
end

-- Function to detect if a card is a unit card
function isUnitCard(object)
    if object.type ~= "Card" then return false end

    local is_unit = false
    local guid = object.getGUID()
    -- Try to parse GM notes as JSON first
    local success, json = pcall(function() return JSON.decode(object.getGMNotes()) end)
    if success and json and json.type and TYPES[json.type] then
        is_unit = true

        -- If this is the first time we're seeing this card, set its initial buff count and original might
        if json.might and buffCounts[guid] == nil then
            -- Store original might value if not already stored
            if originalMightValues[guid] == nil then
                originalMightValues[guid] = tonumber(json.might) or 0
            end
            -- Ensure might is converted to number
            buffCounts[guid] = tonumber(json.might) or 0
            lastAction[guid] = "initial"
        end
    end

    -- Fallback to string pattern matching
    if not is_unit and object.getGMNotes() and string.find(string.lower(object.getGMNotes()), "type%s*=%s*unit") then
        is_unit = true
        -- Try to find might value with pattern matching
        local might = string.match(string.lower(object.getGMNotes()), "might%s*:%s*(%d+)")
        if might and buffCounts[guid] == nil then
            -- Store original might value if not already stored
            if originalMightValues[guid] == nil then
                originalMightValues[guid] = tonumber(might) or 0
            end
            buffCounts[guid] = tonumber(might) or 0
            lastAction[guid] = "initial"
        end
    end

    -- Initialize buff count if not set and card is a unit
    if is_unit and buffCounts[guid] == nil then
        -- Store original might value if not already stored
        if originalMightValues[guid] == nil then
            originalMightValues[guid] = 0
        end
        buffCounts[guid] = 0
        lastAction[guid] = "initial"
    end
    return is_unit

end

-- Update the UI elements on a card based on buff count
function updateCardUI(card)
    local guid = card.getGUID()
    -- Ensure count is a number
    local count = tonumber(buffCounts[guid]) or 0

    -- Check if card is face down - if so, remove the UI and return
    if card.is_face_down then
        card.UI.setXml("")
        return
    end

    -- Get the original might value from our stored values
    local originalMight = originalMightValues[guid] or 0

    -- Determine text color based on count relative to original might
    local textColor = "white" -- Default color when equal to original
    if count > originalMight then
        textColor = "rgba(0,200,0,1)" -- Green color when above original
    elseif count < originalMight then
        textColor = "rgba(200,0,0,1)" -- Red color when below original
    end

    -- Calculate proper aspect ratio based on the original image dimensions (1659x873)
    local imageRatio = 873 / 1659 -- height/width ratio
    local imageWidth = 160
    local imageHeight = imageWidth * imageRatio

    -- Show counter with icon and outlined text - always visible for unit cards
    local xmlUI = [[
    <Defaults>
        <Text color="]] .. textColor .. [[" fontSize="70" fontStyle="Bold" alignment="MiddleCenter" outline="rgba(0,0,0,1)" outlineSize="3 3" />
    </Defaults>
    <Panel position="-60 -130 -100" width="200" height="100" scale="0.6 0.6 0.6" rotation="180 180 0">
        <Image image="]] .. ICON_URL .. [[" color="white" width="]] .. imageWidth .. [[" height="]] .. imageHeight .. [[" preserveAspect="true" />
        <Text position="37 0 2" fontSize="80" outline="true" outlineSize="2 2">]] .. count .. [[</Text>
    </Panel>
    ]]
    card.UI.setXml(xmlUI)
end

-- Increase buff count for a card
function increaseBuff(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    local guid = obj.getGUID()

    -- Initialize if not set
    if buffCounts[guid] == nil then
        buffCounts[guid] = 0
    end

    -- Ensure we have a number before incrementing
    local currentCount = tonumber(buffCounts[guid]) or 0
    buffCounts[guid] = currentCount + 1

    -- Set last action to increase for green coloring
    lastAction[guid] = "increase"

    -- Update the might value in GMNotes
    updateCardMightInGMNotes(obj, buffCounts[guid])

    -- Update UI with attachments
    updateCardUIWithAttachments(obj)
end

-- Decrease buff count for a card
function decreaseBuff(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    local guid = obj.getGUID()

    -- Initialize if not set
    if buffCounts[guid] == nil then
        buffCounts[guid] = 0
    end

    -- Ensure we have a number before decrementing - removed the restriction
    local currentCount = tonumber(buffCounts[guid]) or 0
    buffCounts[guid] = currentCount - 1

    -- Set last action to decrease for red coloring
    lastAction[guid] = "decrease"

    -- Update the might value in GMNotes
    updateCardMightInGMNotes(obj, buffCounts[guid])

    -- Update UI with attachments
    updateCardUIWithAttachments(obj)
end

-- Function to update the might value in a card's GMNotes
function updateCardMightInGMNotes(card, newMightValue)
    local gm_notes = card.getGMNotes()

    if not gm_notes or gm_notes == "" then
        return -- No GMNotes to update
    end

    -- Try to parse as JSON first
    local success, json = pcall(function() return JSON.decode(gm_notes) end)

    if success and json then
        -- Update might value in JSON format
        json.might = newMightValue
        card.setGMNotes(JSON.encode(json))
    else
        -- Fallback to string pattern matching and replacement
        local updatedNotes = gm_notes

        -- Look for might: number pattern and replace it
        updatedNotes = string.gsub(updatedNotes, "might%s*:%s*%d+", "might: " .. newMightValue)

        -- If no match found, try to find might = number pattern
        if updatedNotes == gm_notes then
            updatedNotes = string.gsub(updatedNotes, "might%s*=%s*%d+", "might = " .. newMightValue)
        end

        card.setGMNotes(updatedNotes)
    end
end

-- Attachment system constants and functions
ATTACHMENT_TYPES = {
    buff = {
        name = "Buff",
        image = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/10733003420101246799/B6540E3BCA36A9D05B85D0944C13BF8EF5A4C5B1/"
    }
}

-- Toggle attachment dropdown for a card
function toggleAttachmentDropdown(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    local guid = obj.getGUID()

    if dropdownStates[guid] then
        -- Close dropdown
        dropdownStates[guid] = nil
        refreshButtons()
    else
        -- Open dropdown - first close any other open dropdowns
        dropdownStates = {}
        dropdownStates[guid] = true
        refreshButtons()
    end
end

-- Close attachment dropdown for a card
function closeAttachmentDropdown(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    local guid = obj.getGUID()
    dropdownStates[guid] = nil
    refreshButtons()
end

-- Add attachment to a card
function addAttachment(obj, player_color, alt_click, attachmentType)
    local guid = obj.getGUID()

    -- Initialize attachments for this card if not exists
    if not cardAttachments[guid] then
        cardAttachments[guid] = {}
    end

    -- Check if card already has a different attachment type
    local hasOtherAttachment = false
    for attType, count in pairs(cardAttachments[guid]) do
        if attType ~= attachmentType and count > 0 then
            hasOtherAttachment = true
            break
        end
    end

    if hasOtherAttachment then
        -- Alert player and close menu
        broadcastToAll(player_color .. " - Card may only have one attachment type!", {r=1, g=0.3, b=0.3})
        dropdownStates[guid] = nil
        refreshButtons()
        return
    end

    -- Add the attachment
    if not cardAttachments[guid][attachmentType] then
        cardAttachments[guid][attachmentType] = 0
    end
    cardAttachments[guid][attachmentType] = cardAttachments[guid][attachmentType] + 1

    -- Close dropdown and refresh
    dropdownStates[guid] = nil
    refreshButtons()
end

-- Remove attachment from a card
function removeAttachment(obj, player_color, alt_click, attachmentType)
    local guid = obj.getGUID()

    if cardAttachments[guid] and cardAttachments[guid][attachmentType] and cardAttachments[guid][attachmentType] > 0 then
        cardAttachments[guid][attachmentType] = cardAttachments[guid][attachmentType] - 1

        -- Remove attachment type if count reaches 0
        if cardAttachments[guid][attachmentType] == 0 then
            cardAttachments[guid][attachmentType] = nil
        end

        -- Close dropdown and refresh
        dropdownStates[guid] = nil
        refreshButtons()
    end
end

-- Update card UI to include attachments
function updateCardUIWithAttachments(card)
    local guid = card.getGUID()
    local count = tonumber(buffCounts[guid]) or 0

    -- Check if card is face down - if so, remove the UI and return
    if card.is_face_down then
        card.UI.setXml("")
        return
    end

    -- Get the original might value from our stored values
    local originalMight = originalMightValues[guid] or 0

    -- Determine text color based on count relative to original might
    local textColor = "white" -- Default color when equal to original
    if count > originalMight then
        textColor = "rgba(0,200,0,1)" -- Green color when above original
    elseif count < originalMight then
        textColor = "rgba(200,0,0,1)" -- Red color when below original
    end

    -- Calculate proper aspect ratio based on the original image dimensions (1659x873)
    local imageRatio = 873 / 1659 -- height/width ratio
    local imageWidth = 160
    local imageHeight = imageWidth * imageRatio

    -- Build UI XML
    local xmlUI = [[
    <Defaults>
        <Text color="]] .. textColor .. [[" fontSize="70" fontStyle="Bold" alignment="MiddleCenter" outline="rgba(0,0,0,1)" outlineSize="3 3" />
    </Defaults>
    <Panel position="-60 -130 -100" width="200" height="100" scale="0.6 0.6 0.6" rotation="180 180 0">
        <Image image="]] .. ICON_URL .. [[" color="white" width="]] .. imageWidth .. [[" height="]] .. imageHeight .. [[" preserveAspect="true" />
        <Text position="37 0 2" fontSize="80" outline="true" outlineSize="2 2">]] .. count .. [[</Text>
    </Panel>
    ]]

    -- Add buff image to dropdown menu if menu is open
    if dropdownStates[guid] then
        xmlUI = xmlUI .. [[
        <Panel position="140 -45 -50" width="80" height="80" scale="0.6 0.6 0.6" rotation="180 180 0">
            <Image image="https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/10733003420101246799/B6540E3BCA36A9D05B85D0944C13BF8EF5A4C5B1/" color="white" width="80" height="80" preserveAspect="true" />
        </Panel>
        ]]
    end

    -- Add attachment display if any attachments exist (only when dropdown is closed)
    if not dropdownStates[guid] and cardAttachments[guid] then
        for attachmentType, attachmentCount in pairs(cardAttachments[guid]) do
            if attachmentCount > 0 and ATTACHMENT_TYPES[attachmentType] then
                local attachment = ATTACHMENT_TYPES[attachmentType]

                -- Add attachment image in center
                xmlUI = xmlUI .. [[
                <Panel position="0 0 -100" width="120" height="120" scale="0.8 0.8 0.8" rotation="180 180 0">
                    <Image image="]] .. attachment.image .. [[" color="white" width="120" height="120" preserveAspect="true" />
                ]]

                -- Add count if more than 1
                if attachmentCount > 1 then
                    xmlUI = xmlUI .. [[
                    <Text position="45 -45 2" fontSize="60" color="white" outline="rgba(0,0,0,1)" outlineSize="2 2">]] .. attachmentCount .. [[</Text>
                    ]]
                end

                xmlUI = xmlUI .. [[
                </Panel>
                ]]
                break -- Only show one attachment type
            end
        end
    end

    card.UI.setXml(xmlUI)
end

-- Specific functions for buff attachment
function addBuffAttachment(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    addAttachment(obj, player_color, alt_click, "buff")
end

function removeBuffAttachment(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    removeAttachment(obj, player_color, alt_click, "buff")
end

function refreshButtons()
    -- Remove all buttons from cards in the zone (but preserve deck buttons)
    for _, obj in ipairs(self.getObjects()) do
        if obj.type == "Card" then
          if ThisZoneCaresAboutThisObject(obj)then
            obj.clearButtons()
            -- Also clear UI for face-down cards
            if obj.is_face_down then
                obj.UI.setXml("")
            end
          end
        end
    end

    -- Add buttons to cards and update deck displays
    for _, obj in ipairs(self.getObjects()) do
        if ThisZoneCaresAboutThisObject(obj) then
          if obj.type == "Card" and not obj.is_face_down then
              local has_token = false
              local is_unit = isUnitCard(obj)
              print(is_unit)
              -- Check if card has token info in GMNotes
              local gm_notes = obj.getGMNotes()
              if gm_notes and gm_notes ~= "" then
                  local success, json = pcall(function() return JSON.decode(gm_notes) end)
                  if success and json and json.token then
                      has_token = true
                  end
              end

              -- Add spawn token button if card has token info
              if has_token then
                  local params = {
                      function_owner = self,
                      label = "✦",  -- Spawn symbol
                      position = {0.8, 0.3, 0},
                      scale = {0.5, 0.5, 0.5},
                      width = 600,
                      height = 600,
                      color = {0, 0, 0, 1},
                      font_color = {250, 215, 0, 1},
                      font_size = 500,
                      tooltip = "Spawn token",
                      click_function = "spawnToken"
                  }
                  obj.createButton(params)
              end

              -- Add might counter buttons if card is a unit
              if is_unit then
                  -- Add dropdown menu if open
                  if dropdownStates[obj.getGUID()] then
                      -- Close button (X) - replaces the "<" button
                      obj.createButton({
                          function_owner = self,
                          label = "X",
                          position = {-0.9, 0.3, -0.5},
                          scale = {0.8, 0.8, 0.8},
                          width = 300,
                          height = 300,
                          color = {0.8, 0.2, 0.2, 1},
                          font_size = 400,
                          font_color = {1, 1, 1, 1},
                          tooltip = "Close Attachments",
                          click_function = "closeAttachmentDropdown"
                      })

                      -- Buff attachment option - positioned to the left of the X button
                      local buffCount = (cardAttachments[obj.getGUID()] and cardAttachments[obj.getGUID()]["buff"]) or 0

                      -- Buff attachment + button (above the image)
                      obj.createButton({
                          function_owner = self,
                          label = "+",
                          position = {-1.4, 0.7, -1},
                          scale = {0.6, 0.6, 0.6},
                          width = 250,
                          height = 250,
                          color = {0.2, 0.6, 0.2, 1},
                          font_size = 300,
                          font_color = {1, 1, 1, 1},
                          tooltip = "Add Buff",
                          click_function = "addBuffAttachment"
                      })

                      -- Buff attachment - button (below the image, only if we have buffs)
                      if buffCount > 0 then
                          obj.createButton({
                              function_owner = self,
                              label = "-",
                              position = {-1.4, -0.1, 0},
                              scale = {0.6, 0.6, 0.6},
                              width = 250,
                              height = 250,
                              color = {0.6, 0.2, 0.2, 1},
                              font_size = 300,
                              font_color = {1, 1, 1, 1},
                              tooltip = "Remove Buff",
                              click_function = "removeBuffAttachment"
                          })
                      end
                  else
                      -- Add the attachment dropdown button (when menu is closed)
                      obj.createButton({
                          function_owner = self,
                          label = "<",
                          position = {-0.9, 0.3, -0.5},
                          scale = {0.8, 0.8, 0.8},
                          width = 300,
                          height = 300,
                          color = {0.2, 0.2, 0.6, 1},
                          font_size = 350,
                          font_color = {1, 1, 1, 1},
                          tooltip = "Attachments",
                          click_function = "toggleAttachmentDropdown"
                      })
                  end

                  -- Add the + button for might
                  obj.createButton({
                      function_owner = self,
                      label = "+",
                      position = {-0.5, 0.5, 1.5},
                      scale = {1, 1, 0.8},
                      width = 300,
                      height = 300,
                      color = {0.1, 0.6, 0.1, 1},
                      font_size = 400,
                      font_color = {1, 1, 1, 1},
                      tooltip = "Increase might",
                      click_function = "increaseBuff"
                  })

                  -- Add the - button for might
                  obj.createButton({
                      function_owner = self,
                      label = "-",
                      position = {0.5, 0.5, 1.5},
                      scale = {1, 1, 0.8},
                      width = 300,
                      height = 300,
                      color = {0.7, 0.1, 0.1, 1},
                      font_size = 400,
                      font_color = {1, 1, 1, 1},
                      tooltip = "Decrease might",
                      click_function = "decreaseBuff"
                  })

                  -- Update counter UI with attachments
                  updateCardUIWithAttachments(obj)
              end
          elseif obj.type == "Card" and obj.is_face_down then
              obj.UI.setXml("")
          end
       end
    end
end

-- Helper function to check if object is in a specific zone
function isInZone(object, zone)
    for _, objZone in ipairs(object.getZones()) do
        if objZone.guid == zone.guid then
          if ThisZoneCaresAboutThisObject(object) then
            return true
          end
        end
    end
    return false
end

function ThisZoneCaresAboutThisObject(object)
  if object then
    if object.tag == "Card" and object.getName() ~= "flourish" then
      if object.getGMNotes() ~= "" then
        local parsednotes = Global.call("parseGMNotes", object.getGMNotes())
        if parsednotes.type == "unit" or parsednotes.type =="champion" then
          return true
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return false
end

function onObjectDrop(player_color, object)
    for _, v in ipairs(object.getZones()) do
        if v.guid == self.guid then
          if ThisZoneCaresAboutThisObject(object) then
            object.setVelocity({0, 0, 0}) -- Stop object movement
            Wait.time(function()
                refreshButtons()
            end, 0.2)
          end
        end
    end
end

function onObjectEnterZone(zone, object)
    if zone.guid == self.guid then
      if ThisZoneCaresAboutThisObject(object) then
        Wait.time(function()
            refreshButtons()
        end, 0.2)
      end
    end
end

-- Helper function to clean up card when it leaves the zone
function cleanupCard(card)
    if card.type == "Card" then
        card.clearButtons()
        card.UI.setXml("")
    elseif card.type == "Deck" then
        card.clearButtons()
        deckCounts[card.getGUID()] = nil
        deckOrientations[card.getGUID()] = nil
    end
end

function onObjectLeaveZone(zone, object)
    if zone.guid == self.guid then
      if ThisZoneCaresAboutThisObject(object) then
        -- Immediately clean up the card that's leaving
        cleanupCard(object)

        Wait.time(function()
            refreshButtons()
        end, 0.2) -- Delay of 0.2 seconds
      end
    end
end

-- Add function to handle card flips
function onObjectRotate(object, spin, flip, player_color, old_spin, old_flip)

    -- Detect face change (Z crosses 90° threshold)
    local wasFaceDown = math.abs(old_flip - 180) < 90
    local isFaceDown = math.abs(flip - 180) < 90

    if wasFaceDown == isFaceDown then return end  -- No change

    -- Your logic (zone + unit check)
    if isUnitCard(object) and isInZone(object, self) and ThisZoneCaresAboutThisObject(object) then
        if isFaceDown then
            object.UI.setXml("")
            object.clearButtons()
        else
            Wait.time(function()
                refreshButtons()
            end, 0.1)
        end
    end
end
